Introduction 
CJT series smart transmitter is the field pressure instrument adopting the 
microprocessor as its core, which extends the communication and other 
functions on the basis of the traditional capacitance sensor technology. With the 
help of hand held communicator or other host computer adopting HART protocol, 
the bi-directional communication (data reading, writing and diagnosing) could be 
realized in the control room, transmitter field or any places connecting with 
control circuit. 
With CJT series smart transmitters, measurement of pressure, flow and liquid 
level etc. is available to meet a wide range of applications and requirements 
including petroleum, chemical industry, steel, electric power, environmental 
protection and so on. 
Working Principles 
A/D convertor transforms the current of the modulator to the digital signal, which 
will be used by the microprocessor to judge the input pressure value. The 
microprocessor controls the work of transmitter. Besides, it is also engaged in 
such operations as the sensor linearization, resetting measuring range, 
engineering unit conversion, damping, square root and sensor trim, as well as 
diagnosis and digital communication.

Span and Zero 
Span and zero may be accessed with local adjustments or 
remotely through HART-compatible interface. 
Zero Elevation and Suppression 
Zero elevation and suppression must be such that the lower 
range value is greater than or equal to the (-URL) and the 
upper range value is less than or equal to the (+URL). The 
calibrated span must be greater than or equal to the minimum 
span and less than or equal to the maximum span. 
Damping 
Time constant is adjustable in 0.06 second increments from 
0.06 seconds to 32.0 seconds. 
Failure Mode Alarm 
If self-diagnosis detects a gross transmitter failure, the analog 
signal will be driven 3.8 mA or 21.6 mA to alert the user. 
High or low alarm signal is software-selectable via the 
HART-compatible interface or hardware-selectable via the 
optional switch on the electrical part.

CJT YFGP REMOTE GAGE PRESSURE TRANSMITTER 
CJT YFGP remote gage pressure transmitter can prevent the isolating diaphragm of the transmitter from being directly touched with 
the measured medium. It is applicable to the following situations: 
 
The high temperature medium is necessary to be 
isolated from the transmitter; 
 
The measured medium will bring corrosion to the 
transmitter connector and the sensitive element; 
 
There are suspended solid particles in the measured 
medium or high-viscous, which will easily result in 
plugging of transmitter connector and pressure chamber; 
 
The measured medium is easy to solidify or crystallize 
when being induced out by induced pressure tube; 
 
Water flush is needed before the measured medium is 
changed while the measured medium not allow of mixing; 
 
It is required to maintain the sanitary condition and prevent 
from pollution.

Chapter 1
Overview
The CJT smart transmitter detects the differential pressure or pressure of various fluids,
converts it into a current signal of 4 to 20mA DC and transmits it.
All the adjustment functions are incorporated in the transmission unit for making adjustments
easily and exactly.
Transmitter settings (such as range and damping time constant, etc.) can be changed from
an HHC (Hand Held Communicator).
1.1
Principle
A/D convertor transforms the current of the modulator to the digital signal, which will be used
by the microprocessor to judge the input pressure value. The microprocessor controls the
work of transmitter. Besides, it is also engaged in such operations as the sensor linearization,
resetting measuring range, engineering unit conversion, damping, square root and sensor
trim, as well as diagnosis and digital communication.
The operating principle of the CJT series transmitter is shown in the block diagram below.
Figure 1- 1 Working principle

2
Chapter 2 Cautions on Use
Unpack the box and check the contents according to packing List before operating the
transmitter. If any of the contents are not correct or missing or if there is any physical
damage, contact our customer service.
The instrument nameplate is attached at the transmission unit of this transmitter. Before use,
make sure the contents of the nameplate agree exactly with your specifications.
Individuals who handle products exposed to a hazardous substance
can avoid injury if they are informed of and understand the hazard.
2.1
Storage conditions

Environmental temperature: (-20~60)℃.

Relative humidity: <95% RH.

Keep original state before use.

No excessive amount of soot, steam, dust, or corrosive gases.

Whenever shutting down the transmitter for a long period, remove any process fluid
from the transmitter pressure-detector section. During draining condensate from the
pressure detector section, take appropriate care to avoid contact with the skin, eyes or
body, or inhalation of vapors, if the accumulated process fluid may be toxic or
otherwise harmful.
2.2
Installation location
Mount the transmitter to minimize ambient temperature changes, vibration, mechanical
shock, and to avoid external contact with corrosive materials. When choosing an installation
location and position, take into account the need for access to the transmitter.

Chapter 2 Cautions on Use
3

Provide 0.5m clearance for installation, tubing, wiring and maintenance.

Well ventilated to prevent the transmitter from corrosive gases.

No heat radiation and direct sunlight.

Little mechanical vibration, shock and temperature fluctuation.

Installation of this transmitter in an explosive or an incendive environment must be in
accordance with explosion-proof instruments mounting standards. Please review this
section in 2.5 for a safe installation.
2.3
Applying pressure

Install and tighten all four flange bolts before applying pressure.

No leaks from impulse piping, process leaks may cause harm or result in death.

Pressing within specifications.

Do not attempt to loosen or remove flange bolts while pressing state.

Insure the testing harmful substance is directed away from you even the pressure is
released, since the accumulated liquid (or gas) may be toxic or otherwise harmful.
2.4
Waterproof of electric interface
Assemble the suited seal joint of transmitter with a thread sealant for waterproof.
2.5
Installation of explosion-proof transmitters
2.5.1
Intrinsically safe transmitters
The intrinsically safe transmitters, which are certified by the National Supervision and
Inspection Center for Explosion Protection and Safety of Instrumentation (NEPSI), comply
with GB3836.1-2000 (eqv IEC60079-0:1998) and GB3836.4-2000 (eqv IEC60079-11:1999).
The intrinsically-safe transmitters can be used in hazardous areas with volatile gas or
flammable steam.

Using with barriers can guarantee the Intrinsic Safety. The barriers must comply with
GB3836.1-2000 and GB3836.4-2000.

The connection of barriers in hazardous areas must connect in accordance with Users’
manual.

The mounting wiring must comply with national mounting provision for explosion-proof

CJT Smart Transmitter
4
apparatus.

Pressure transmitter with intrinsic safety type protection is not valid if it is not
connected to an intrinsic safety circuit.
2.5.2
Explosion-proof transmitters
The explosion-proof transmitters, which are certified by the National Supervision and
Inspection Center for Explosion Protection and Safety of Instrumentation (NEPSI), comply
with GB3836.1-2000 and GB3836.2-2000. The explosion-proof transmitters can be used in
hazardous areas with volatile gas or flammable steam.

Examine the explosion-proof form, level and group carefully when installing.

Earth using the earth terminals on housing when installing.

The mounting wiring must comply with national mounting provision for explosion-proof
apparatus.

Ensure the proper seal when installing.

Do not refit each structure in transmitter.

Do not remove the transmitter covers in explosive atmospheres when the circuit is live.

Take care not to generate mechanical sparking when access to the instrument and
peripheral devices in hazardous locations.
This instrument is tested and certified as intrinsically safe type or
explosion proof type. Please note that the construction of the
instrument, installation, external wiring, maintenance or repair is strictly
restricted, and non-observance or negligence of this restriction would
result in dangerous condition.
To preserve the safety of explosion-proof equipment requires great
care during mounting, wiring, and piping. Safety requirements also
place restrictions on maintenance and repair activities. Please read the
following sections very carefully.

The transmitter is heavy. Be careful when handling it.

3.3
Piping
It is generally recognized that there are appropriate positioning relationship between the
transmitter and main process piping for accurate measurement to avoid harmful gas or liquid
accumulation.
a) Mount transmitter below main process piping for liquid or steam measurement. The
standard styles of CJT smart transmitter correspond to this piping procedure.
b) Mount transmitter above main process piping for gas measurement. Change the
vent/drain plug to correspond to this piping procedure.
Main valve used for piping should be selected with the maximum
pressure of the process taken into account (piping parts such as main
valve, etc. should be furnished by user). If the main valve and other
parts do not meet the rating, it may result in leakage of gas or liquid
which could lead to a hazard.
3.3.1
Piping of DP
(1) Check of high/low pressure sides of transmitter
The detecting unit of the differential pressure transmitter bears symbols H and L which
represent high and low pressure sides, respectively. Also, vent/drain plugs are provided at
the lower process connection, while impulse pipes are connected at the upper process
connections.
Figure 3- 6
(2) Removal of protective cap
The process connection ports of the transmitter and manifold (equalizer) valve are fitted with
protective caps. Before piping, be sure to remove the caps. When removing the caps,
carefully protect the threaded portion and sealing face from damage.
(3) Position of process taps (Horizontal main process piping)

characteristics and measuring point of the process fluid.

Make piping so that gas in the impulse pipe is not delivered to the transmitter, and
incorporate gas reservoirs as required.

7.1
Periodic inspection
In order to ensure the measurement accuracy and long life of the transmitter, it is essential to
inspect the transmitter periodically according to the operating conditions.
(1) Visual inspection
Visually inspect each part of the transmitter for damage, corrosion, etc. If you detect any
material which may cause corrosion, it should be cleaned off.
(2) Check of cover and O-ring
The transmitter has a water and dust-proof construction. Make sure the O-ring of the case
cover is not damaged or deteriorated. Carefully prevent foreign materials from sticking to
threads.
(3) Piping leakage check
Using soapy water or the like, check the all process connections for leakage of process fluid.
If necessary, drain the moisture which has accumulated in the transmitter and process pipe.

Smart Transmitter
CXT Series
Data Sheet
1
Overview
CXT smart pressure transmitter adopts a unique mono-silicon composite pressure sensor, advanced integral capsule structure and high
reliability modular circuit design, accuracy up to 0.035%, stability up to ±0.1%/10 years.
The product has complete smart diagnosis, monitoring, configuration functions, support a variety of digital communication, with complete
specifications of liquid connection materials, high index electromagnetic compatibility and lightning protection functions, suitable for
petroleum, electric power, chemical, metallurgy, pharmaceutical, light industry and other industries in the pressure, flow and level
measurement and many other occasions.

sensor
Advanced MEMS of the
sensor
Modular
circuit technology

Dual temperature sensor:
For greatly improve the temperature
characteristics of the product, the temperature
sensors which are built in the sensor unit and
the electronic device are used for the
temperature compensation of the sensor and
circuit respectively.

Advanced MEMS of the sensor:
The core device is manufactured based on
micro and nano processing technology. The
sensor integrates temperature sensor inside
and adopts integrated anti-overload design.
The main body is made of 316 stainless steel
and the wetted material can be adapted to


Modular circuit technology :
Advanced microelectronics technology is
adopted to realize high-precision signal
acquisition and detection through modular

reliability, good stability and easy maintenance.

Data sheet
2
Principle of operation
Working principle diagram
Pressure sensor and temperature sensor signals are amplified and converted into digital signals by high-speed A/D converter, data
processing in the microprocessor, and output to the user system through different signal transmission methods. For example, (4 ~20)
mADC superimposed HART signal; PROFIBUS-PA, FF, RS485, APL digital signals; Wireless HART, 5G and other wireless signals. The
main data affecting the meter operation is stored in the EEPROM of the sensor unit, which supports arbitrary matching of smart electrical
conversion parts. The user can adjust the parameter configuration through the zero knob and the three buttons of the LCD back panel, or
through the communication equipment supporting HART, PROFIBUS-PA or FF protocol.
Working principle of sensor
Differential Pressure Transmitter
The process medium exerts pressure on the measuring diaphragm
on the high and low pressure sides of the pressure sensor through
a flexible, corrosion-resistant isolation diaphragm as well as a
filling fluid. The sensor adopts full welding technology, integrated
overload protection structure, internal integrated temperature
sensor. Differential pressure is transmitted to the silicon chip in the
sensor through the isolation diaphragm and filling liquid, so that the
electrical parameters of the differential pressure sensor chip
change, resulting in the detection system output voltage change,
the output voltage is proportional to the pressure change, and then
converted into a standardized signal output by the adaptation unit
and the amplifier.
Note: There is no overload diaphragm in differential pressure
mounted pressure and absolute pressure transmitters.
Multi-parameter option instrument built-in static pressure
measurement unit, can achieve synchronous measurement.

Smart Transmitter
CXT Series
Data Sheet
3
Direct Mount Transmitter
The process medium exerts pressure on the measuring diaphragm
of the pressure sensor through the flexible, corrosion-resistant
isolation diaphragm and the filling liquid. The other end of the
measuring diaphragm of the pressure sensor is connected to the
atmosphere (for gauge pressure measurement) or vacuum (for
absolute pressure measurement) ). As a result, the electrical
parameters of the silicon chip of the sensor change, leading to
changes in the output voltage of the detection system. The output
voltage is proportional to the pressure change, and then converted
into a standardized signal output by the adapting unit and amplifier.


Standard accuracy: ±0.05%FS (maximum ±0.035%FS).

Turn Down: 100:1 for SKC, SKG, SKA, SKP, SKH, 30:1 for SKE, SKD, SKB, SKQ, SKR.



Range: differential pressure 0 ~ 100Pa-14MPa, pressure 0 ~ 1kPa-70MPa.






process temperature (-75 ~ 700) ℃.







Dielectric strength: 500VAC, 50/60Hz, between the circuit and the ground, shall not result in breakdown or flashover for 1 minute.



Protection class: IP66/IP67.

Vibration effect: ≤±0.1%FS (frequency (10 ~ 150) Hz, amplitude 0.075 mm, acceleration 9.8 m/s, 30 minutes).

Lightning protection function: built into the terminal, can prevent lightning damage meter. Performance: 4kV (1.2×50μs), allowable
current: maximum 6000 A (1×40μs), 100 cycles of 1000A (1×40μs).
Advantages and benefits

High reliability
The standard accuracy of CXT smart transmitter is 0.05%FS (maximum 0.035%FS). After years of field verification, the product can still
achieve 0.05%accuracy after 10 years of continuous use. The product adopts strong metal housing and high reliability industrial
measuring components, with good industrial field adaptability, such as anti-electromagnetic interference ability, lightning protection, etc.,

Data sheet
4
to ensure the high reliability of the product.

Smart function
The CXT smart transmitter has an integrated diagnostic function to monitor the running process and its own status in real time. After more
than a defined number of events, the transmitter enters a fault alarm state and outputs an alarm current to provide a control signal for the
system interlocking or SIS safety system. When the fault occurs, the LCD display automatically displays warnings, and automatically
analyzes and displays the faulty components, making the instrument maintenance, repair and replacement more simple and convenient.
The diagnosis function can also be started through HART, FF, PA and other protocol communication, and the alarm can be expressed in
the form of warning or fault protection current. When the electronic unit or measuring element is damaged, the faulty component can be
replaced directly on site. Pro high-end products with multifunctional display and touch button function, more abundant content, can
display all kinds of measurement parameters on the same screen, a variety of language support, and with parameter record saving
function.

HART or bus communication configuration
The user can adjust all parameters using a PC or laptop, handheld communicator or any compatible process control system software with
the help of bus communication protocols such as HART, PA, FF, APL, etc.

A variety of anti-corrosion materials
For corrosion process conditions, the isolation diaphragm has a variety of choices, such as 316L, Hastelloy, tantalum, Monel 400 alloy,
nickel, titanium or 316L gold plating, and other parts. Wetted parts (e.g flange/ vent valves/membranes/ insert cylinder components) can
also be selected according to the measuring medium, so as to ensure the reliable operation of the product.

Certification
CXT smart transmitter has passed the National Instrument Explosion Safety (NEPSI) certification, China Classification Society
Certification CCS, IEC International explosion certification, EU explosion certification, as well as SIL, PROFIBUS-PA, Fieldbus
Foundation, HART and other international certifications.

PA Field Bus Type Pressure Transmitter
97
PA Field Bus Type Pressure Transmitter
Profibus-PA (Process Automation) is a digital communication Bus technology used in the Field of industrial automation. It is a
communication standard of PROFIBUS (Process Field Bus), specially designed for process control and process automation applications.
Based on MBP physical signal transmission technology, the basic functions of PROFIBUS-DP are used to transmit measurement values
and status, and it is extended to formulate parameters of field equipment and operate equipment, provide high-speed, reliable
communication, and support real-time control and monitoring in industrial environments.
Characteristics
Interoperability
PROFIBUS-PA uses digital communication between field devices (such as sensors, actuators, controllers, etc.) to realize data
transmission. The protocol specification ensures the interchangeability and interoperability of field devices produced by different
manufacturers.
Function Block
The CXT series PA bus pressure transmitters have two separate FB function modules to measure pressure/differential pressure and
temperature. It also has 1 PB physical block and 1 TB transformation block for managing device storage and running data.
General Purpose Indicator
Communication Protocol
Compliant with PROFIBUS PA3.02, this equipment is factory enabled to communicate with any PROFIBUS Class 1 master with generic
profile GSD (9701) or GSD (117E) for CXT series PA pressure transmitters. The fieldbus communication passes the PNO test of PI
(PROFIBUS International Organization) and PROFIBU-PA product certification.
Power Supply
Common, flameproof : (9~32) VDC, support polarity reverse connection.
Intrinsically safe: (9~24) VDC, support polarity reverse connection.
Profibus-PA Cable
PROFIBUS-PA bus communication is recommended to use A class A cable (cable in accordance with the requirements of IEC61158-2
standard).

Wireless HART Pressure Transmitter
99
Wireless HART Pressure Transmitter
Wireless HART communication uses 2.4GHz ISM band wireless communication
technology, which retains the traditional HART transmitter's original functions of two-wire
communication, process measurement and so on, and extends the device's wireless
communication function. This wireless communication technology is the world's first
internationally certified industrial wireless communication technology standard, and has
also been approved by the IEC, becoming a public available communication specification.
CXT series wireless HART pressure transmitter can transmit pressure, differential
pressure, temperature and other parameters, providing a more flexible communication
function, greatly reducing the use of cable, bringing users a more efficient and convenient
wireless measurement solution.
Characteristics
Wireless Mesh Network
Wireless HART network is based on Mesh network. The devices in the network have routing function, and usually have multiple routing
paths, which are automatically assigned and maintained by the gateway.
AD Hoc Network Capabilities
Support device automatic on-line, network status detection and offline reconnect functions. The gateway dynamically optimizes the
routing of each device according to the real-time routing status of the device.
Data Reliability
The data reliability of wireless HART network is >99.9%.
Multiple Configurations
The instrument can be configured through the hand-operated device, the corresponding host computer software and the wireless
gateway Web management page.
Alarm Function
Support high and low alarm, module abnormal alarm and so on.
Self-diagnosis Function
It supports device self-diagnosis, which can detect pressure sensor fault, temperature sensor fault, etc., and support uploading and Web
monitoring of device status information such as battery life time.

Smart Transmitter
CXT Series
Data Sheet
1
Overview
CXT smart pressure transmitter adopts a unique mono-silicon composite pressure sensor, advanced integral capsule structure and high
reliability modular circuit design, accuracy up to 0.035%, stability up to ±0.1%/10 years.
The product has complete smart diagnosis, monitoring, configuration functions, support a variety of digital communication, with complete
specifications of liquid connection materials, high index electromagnetic compatibility and lightning protection functions, suitable for
petroleum, electric power, chemical, metallurgy, pharmaceutical, light industry and other industries in the pressure, flow and level
measurement and many other occasions.
Dual temperature
sensor
Advanced MEMS of the
sensor
Modular
circuit technology

Dual temperature sensor:
For greatly improve the temperature
characteristics of the product, the temperature
sensors which are built in the sensor unit and
the electronic device are used for the

circuit respectively.


The core device is manufactured based on

Data sheet
2
Principle of operation
Working principle diagram
Pressure sensor and temperature sensor signals are amplified and converted into digital signals by high-speed A/D converter, data
processing in the microprocessor, and output to the user system through different signal transmission methods. For example, (4 ~20)
mADC superimposed HART signal; PROFIBUS-PA, FF, RS485, APL digital signals; Wireless HART, 5G and other wireless signals. The
main data affecting the meter operation is stored in the EEPROM of the sensor unit, which supports arbitrary matching of smart electrical
conversion parts. The user can adjust the parameter configuration through the zero knob and the three buttons of the LCD back panel, or
through the communication equipment supporting HART, PROFIBUS-PA or FF protocol.
Working principle of sensor
Differential Pressure Transmitter
The process medium exerts pressure on the measuring diaphragm
on the high and low pressure sides of the pressure sensor through
a flexible, corrosion-resistant isolation diaphragm as well as a
filling fluid. The sensor adopts full welding technology, integrated
overload protection structure, internal integrated temperature
sensor. Differential pressure is transmitted to the silicon chip in the
sensor through the isolation diaphragm and filling liquid, so that the
electrical parameters of the differential pressure sensor chip
change, resulting in the detection system output voltage change,
the output voltage is proportional to the pressure change, and then
converted into a standardized signal output by the adaptation unit
and the amplifier.
Note: There is no overload diaphragm in differential pressure
mounted pressure and absolute pressure transmitters.
Multi-parameter option instrument built-in static pressure
measurement unit, can achieve synchronous measurement.

Smart Transmitter
CXT Series
Data Sheet
3
Direct Mount Transmitter
The process medium exerts pressure on the measuring diaphragm
of the pressure sensor through the flexible, corrosion-resistant
isolation diaphragm and the filling liquid. The other end of the
measuring diaphragm of the pressure sensor is connected to the
atmosphere (for gauge pressure measurement) or vacuum (for
absolute pressure measurement) ). As a result, the electrical
parameters of the silicon chip of the sensor change, leading to
changes in the output voltage of the detection system. The output
voltage is proportional to the pressure change, and then converted
into a standardized signal output by the adapting unit and amplifier.
Excellent performance

Standard accuracy: ±0.05%FS (maximum ±0.035%FS).

Turn Down: 100:1 for SKC, SKG, SKA, SKP, SKH, 30:1 for SKE, SKD, SKB, SKQ, SKR.

Fastest response time: ≤90ms (sample data refresh time 60ms).

Range: differential pressure 0 ~ 100Pa-14MPa, pressure 0 ~ 1kPa-70MPa.

Output：(4 ~ 20) mA HART（version 7.0）；Profibus-PA（version 3.02）；Foundation Fieldbus（version 6.5.0）, etc.

Over pressure limi: differential pressure 42MPa, pressure 100MPa.

Temperature range: ambient temperature (-40 ~ 85) ℃(explosion-proof type temperature range see explosion-proof grade),
process temperature (-75 ~ 700) ℃.

Ambient humidity: (5 ~ 100) %RH@40℃.

Ambient temperature for LCD display: (-30 ~ 80) ℃.

Long-term drift: ≤±0.1%FS/10 years.

Temperature influence: ± (0.01%+0.06% maximum range/operating range) /28℃.

Dielectric strength: 500VAC, 50/60Hz, between the circuit and the ground, shall not result in breakdown or flashover for 1 minute.

Dielectric resistance: 500VDC, not less than 100MΩ.

Protection class: IP66/IP67.

Vibration effect: ≤±0.1%FS (frequency (10 ~ 150) Hz, amplitude 0.075 mm, acceleration 9.8 m/s, 30 minutes).

Lightning protection function: built into the terminal, can prevent lightning damage meter. Performance: 4kV (1.2×50μs), allowable
current: maximum 6000 A (1×40μs), 100 cycles of 1000A (1×40μs).
Advantages and benefits

High reliability
The standard accuracy of CXT smart transmitter is 0.05%FS (maximum 0.035%FS). After years of field verification, the product can still
achieve 0.05%accuracy after 10 years of continuous use. The product adopts strong metal housing and high reliability industrial
measuring components, with good industrial field adaptability, such as anti-electromagnetic interference ability, lightning protection, etc.,

Data sheet
4
to ensure the high reliability of the product.

Smart function
The CXT smart transmitter has an integrated diagnostic function to monitor the running process and its own status in real time. After more
than a defined number of events, the transmitter enters a fault alarm state and outputs an alarm current to provide a control signal for the
system interlocking or SIS safety system. When the fault occurs, the LCD display automatically displays warnings, and automatically
analyzes and displays the faulty components, making the instrument maintenance, repair and replacement more simple and convenient.
The diagnosis function can also be started through HART, FF, PA and other protocol communication, and the alarm can be expressed in
the form of warning or fault protection current. When the electronic unit or measuring element is damaged, the faulty component can be
replaced directly on site. Pro high-end products with multifunctional display and touch button function, more abundant content, can
display all kinds of measurement parameters on the same screen, a variety of language support, and with parameter record saving
function.

HART or bus communication configuration
The user can adjust all parameters using a PC or laptop, handheld communicator or any compatible process control system software with
the help of bus communication protocols such as HART, PA, FF, APL, etc.

A variety of anti-corrosion materials
For corrosion process conditions, the isolation diaphragm has a variety of choices, such as 316L, Hastelloy, tantalum, Monel 400 alloy,
nickel, titanium or 316L gold plating, and other parts. Wetted parts (e.g flange/ vent valves/membranes/ insert cylinder components) can
also be selected according to the measuring medium, so as to ensure the reliable operation of the product.

Certification
CXT smart transmitter has passed the National Instrument Explosion Safety (NEPSI) certification, China Classification Society
Certification CCS, IEC International explosion certification, EU explosion certification, as well as SIL, PROFIBUS-PA, Fieldbus
Foundation, HART and other international certifications.

SKH Absolute Pressure Transmitter (Direct Mount Type)
The SKH high performance pressure transmitter uses a mono-silicon pressure sensor for measuring absolute pressure of liquids, gases
or vapors. The transmitter converts the measured pressure into (4 ~20) mADC current signal output, with fast response, remote setting
and self-diagnosis functions. Through process converters, we offer high precision sanitary and paper specific pressure transmitters. High
precision hygienic pressure transmitter with hygienic interface for food processing, chemical and pharmaceutical applications. High
precision papermaking pressure transmitter, with a special pressure sensing unit front, to solve the problem of high viscosity medium
easy to jam, especially suitable for papermaking and other easy to jam conditions. CXT series products provide HART, FF fieldbus,
PROFIBUS PA, APL and other communication protocols, and the standard configuration has passed SIL safety certification.

SKR Flange Absolute Pressure Transmitter
SKR high performance flange absolute pressure transmitter adopts mono-silicon pressure sensor, suitable for high and low temperature,
high vacuum, high viscosity and easy crystallization medium absolute pressure. The transmitter converts the measured pressure into (4
~20) mADC current signal output, which has the functions of fast response, remote setting and self-diagnosis. CXT series products
provide HART, FF field bus and PROFIBUS PA, APL and other communication protocols, standard configuration through SIL safety
certification.

PA Field Bus Type Pressure Transmitter
Profibus-PA (Process Automation) is a digital communication Bus technology used in the Field of industrial automation. It is a
communication standard of PROFIBUS (Process Field Bus), specially designed for process control and process automation applications.
Based on MBP physical signal transmission technology, the basic functions of PROFIBUS-DP are used to transmit measurement values
and status, and it is extended to formulate parameters of field equipment and operate equipment, provide high-speed, reliable
communication, and support real-time control and monitoring in industrial environments.
Characteristics
Interoperability
PROFIBUS-PA uses digital communication between field devices (such as sensors, actuators, controllers, etc.) to realize data
transmission. The protocol specification ensures the interchangeability and interoperability of field devices produced by different
manufacturers.
Function Block
The CXT series PA bus pressure transmitters have two separate FB function modules to measure pressure/differential pressure and
temperature. It also has 1 PB physical block and 1 TB transformation block for managing device storage and running data.
General Purpose Indicator
Communication Protocol
Compliant with PROFIBUS PA3.02, this equipment is factory enabled to communicate with any PROFIBUS Class 1 master with generic
profile GSD (9701) or GSD (117E) for CXT series PA pressure transmitters. The fieldbus communication passes the PNO test of PI
(PROFIBUS International Organization) and PROFIBU-PA product certification.
Power Supply

Intrinsically safe: (9~24) VDC, support polarity reverse connection.

Wireless HART Pressure Transmitter
Wireless HART communication uses 2.4GHz ISM band wireless communication
technology, which retains the traditional HART transmitter's original functions of two-wire
communication, process measurement and so on, and extends the device's wireless
communication function. This wireless communication technology is the world's first
internationally certified industrial wireless communication technology standard, and has
also been approved by the IEC, becoming a public available communication specification.
CXT series wireless HART pressure transmitter can transmit pressure, differential
pressure, temperature and other parameters, providing a more flexible communication
function, greatly reducing the use of cable, bringing users a more efficient and convenient
wireless measurement solution.
Characteristics
Wireless Mesh Network
Wireless HART network is based on Mesh network. The devices in the network have routing function, and usually have multiple routing
paths, which are automatically assigned and maintained by the gateway.
AD Hoc Network Capabilities
Support device automatic on-line, network status detection and offline reconnect functions. The gateway dynamically optimizes the
routing of each device according to the real-time routing status of the device.
Data Reliability
The data reliability of wireless HART network is >99.9%.
Multiple Configurations
The instrument can be configured through the hand-operated device, the corresponding host computer software and the wireless
gateway Web management page.
Alarm Function
Support high and low alarm, module abnormal alarm and so on.
Self-diagnosis Function

Chapter 1
Overview
The CXT transmitter detects the differential pressure or pressure of various fluids,
converts it into a current signal of 4 to 20mA DC and transmits it.
All the adjustment functions are incorporated in the amplifier unit for making
adjustments easily and exactly.
Transmitter settings (such as range and damping time constant, etc.) can be changed
from an HHC (Hand Held Communicator) or a local configurator unit with LCD display.
1.1 Principle
The operating principle of the CXT smart transmitter is shown in the block diagram
below.
The input pressure is changed into an electrostatic capacitance in the detecting unit.
The change proportional to the pressure undergoes conditioning and amplification in
the amplifier unit, and is then output as a current of 4 to 20mA DC.
Figure 1- 1
This instrument is tested and certified as intrinsically safe type or
explosion proof type. Please note that the construction of the
instrument, installation, external wiring, maintenance or repair is strictly
restricted, and non-observance or negligence of this restriction would
result in dangerous condition.
To preserve the safety of explosion-proof equipment requires great
care during mounting, wiring, and piping. Safety requirements also
place restrictions on maintenance and repair activities. Please read the
following sections very carefully.

Chapter 3
Installation and Piping
3.1 Installation
After unpacking, check the delivered items.
This transmitter can be mounted on a pipe or on a wall. However, level transmitters
require flange mounting.
Note that the bolts (M8) for wall mounting should be supplied by the customer.
3.1.1
Location
The transmitter is heavy. Be careful when handling it.
a) The transmitter should be installed in a place that meets the operating conditions
shown in Data Sheet or Instruction Manual.
b) Install the transmitter according to the Instruction Manual. Improper installation may
lead to the cause of fall, trouble or incorrect operation.
c) When installing, make sure that the transmitter interior is free from cable chips and
other foreign objects to prevent fire, trouble or incorrect operation.
If the transmitter is not used soon after delivery, then leave it packed
and store it in a room at the normal temperature and humidity (25℃,
60%RH).
Non-explosion-proof transmitter must not be used in a place with
explosive gas to prevent serious accidents such as explosion, fire, etc.
Explosions could result in death or serious injury. Installation of this
transmitter in an explosive environment must be in accordance with the
appropriate local, national, and international standards, codes, and
practices.
Do not step on this instrument after installation.

3.2 Piping
It is generally recognized that there are appropriate positioning relationship between
the transmitter and main process piping for accurate measurement to avoid harmful
gas or liquid accumulation.
a) Mount transmitter below main process piping for liquid or steam measurement. The
standard styles of CXT smart transmitter correspond to this piping procedure.
b) Mount transmitter above main process piping for gas measurement. Change the
vent/drain plug to correspond to this piping procedure.
Main valve used for piping should be selected with the maximum
pressure of the process taken into account (piping parts such as main
valve, etc. should be furnished by user). If the main valve and other
parts do not meet the rating, it may result in leakage of gas or liquid
which could lead to a hazard.
When welding piping during construction, take care not to allow
welding currents to flow through the transmitter.
3.2.1
Piping of differential pressure and flow transmitters
(1) Check of high/low pressure sides of transmitter
The detecting unit of the differential pressure transmitter bears symbols H and L which
represent high and low pressure sides, respectively. Also, vent/drain plugs are
provided at the lower process connection, while impulse pipes are connected at the
upper process connections.

Wiring
4.1 Cautions on wiring

Application of a voltage exceeding 45 VDC or 32 VAC (exceeding 32 VDC or 23
VAC when arrester equipped) between “+” and “–” terminals may result in
damage to the transmitter.

Use a shielded cable for the transmission line where possible.

Avoid installation of signal cable and power cable in same conduit or cable tray
in order to prevent increased noise. Also, do not bring the signal cable close to
large electrical equipment.

In case of an explosion proof arrangement, wiring shall be made in accordance
with the relevant regulations to ensure the explosion proofing.

All wiring shall comply with local installation requirement and local electrical
code.

SUPCON recommends customer to apply the Metal Conduit Wiring or to use the
twisted pair Shield Cable for signal wiring to conform the requirement of EMC
Regulation, when customer installs the CXT Series Transmitters to the plant.

When using a power supply not having a non-incendive circuit, please pay
attention not to ignite in the surrounding flammable atmosphere. In such a case,
we recommend using wiring metal conduit in order to prevent the ignition.

Take care not to generate mechanical sparking when access to the instrument
and peripheral devices in hazardous locations.
4.2 Wiring procedure
Before making wiring work, be sure to turn OFF the main power to prevent electric
shocks.
Use wiring materials of correct rating to prevent fire accidents.
After installing the transmitter, firmly close the covers of the amplifier unit and terminal
box. If not, rain water will enter the transmitter which may result in trouble or incorrect
operation.

7.1 Periodic inspection
In order to ensure the measurement accuracy and long life of the transmitter, it is
essential to inspect the transmitter periodically according to the operating conditions.
(1) Visual inspection
Visually inspect each part of the transmitter for damage, corrosion, etc. If you detect
any material which may cause corrosion, it should be cleaned off.
(2) Check of cover and O-ring
The transmitter has a water and dust-proof construction. Make sure the O-ring of the
case cover is not damaged or deteriorated. Carefully prevent foreign materials from
sticking to threads.

(3) Piping leakage check
Using soapy water or the like, check the all process connections for leakage of
process fluid. If necessary, drain the moisture which has accumulated in the
transmitter and process pipe.

Appendix 1 Built-in Arrester
An arrester is used to protect a transmitter or receiver from an abnormal voltage such
as lightning surges induced into signal lines. A built-in type arrester is mounted behind
the terminal unit. A nameplate marked “with arrester” is attached to the terminal unit of
transmitter with a built-in arrester.
Appendix 1.1 Installation
The built-in arrester should be used in combination with panel mounting type arrester
for distributor protection.
Appendix 1.2 Grounding
Since transmitter and arrester groundings are internally connected together, users
have only to connect the external grounding terminals to ground.
Grounding terminal must be used, in case of the explosion-proof or intrinsic safety type
transmitter.
Grounding resistance should be 100Ωor less.
Avoid common grounding with a lightning rod.

Appendix 1
Built-in Arrester

Appendix 1.3 Maintenance
Check of arrester:
(1) Measure output current from the transmitter check terminals and output current to
flow into transmitter. When current is measured with an ammeter connected to
CHECK+ and CHECK- terminals, the internal resistance of the ammeter should be
12Ωor less.
(2) If the measured two output current are the same, the arrester is normal.
(3) In case the measured values have a difference of 0.1% (0.016mA) or more, the
arrester is not functioning.
(4) In the above case, the arrester unit (terminal unit) should be replaced with a new
one.

The DP flowmeter is applicable for flow measurement and process control of petroleum, chemical, natural gas, metallurgy, 
steel, electric power, water conservancy, pharmaceutical, textile, beverage, energy, environmental protection, urban utilities 
and other industries.
The use of DP principle for flow measurement is one of the most reliable flow measurement methods in the world today. This 
method of measuring flow by using DP has a long history and mature technology. Many countries adopt DP flowmeter  in 
important occasions.
The current DP flowmeter products on the market are: orifice flowmeter, nozzle flowmeter, venturi flowmeter, porous orifice 
flowmeter, wedge flowmeter, annubar flowmeter, verabar flowmeter, cross section flowmeter, conical flowmeter, elbow pipe 
flowmeter, aerofoil flow measurement device, etc.
As the originator of flowmeter, the DP flowmeter represented by the throttle device still dominates the total amount of 
flowmeter in the industrial sector by 1/3 share, individual enterprises even up to 90% or more.
The current standard of DP flowmeter is  GB/T2624-2006 idt ISO5167:2003。
Metering instruments used for trade settlement and various energy production of enterprises should better meet international 
or national standards. In the event of a metering objection, the meter data supported by the standard has the most authority 
in resolving metering objections.
A DP transmitter and a DP flowmeter are installed together to be an integral DP flowmeter. This eliminates the need to lay 
pressure lines in the field, improves dynamic characteristics, reduces maintenance work and failure rate, reduces initial set-
up costs and operating costs.
The SUPCON produces and provides service of DP flowmeter in strict accordance with the quality management system GB 
/ T19001-2016 / ISO9001:2015 standard. All design and calculation software are in strict compliance with international and 
national standards, with impartiality, authority.

Product Overview

The differential pressure flowmeter represented by standard throttle device (standard orifice, standard nozzle, venturi) meets 
international standards, and can predict the relationship between flow and output signal and its measurement error without 
the need for real flow calibration, which is the only flowmeter that can do it. Its research data and production practice are 
extremely rich, so far there is no any flowmeter can be compared with it. It is applicable  throughout the world, recognized by 
the International Organization of Weights and Measures, and is the only flowmeter can be calibrated without water.
Orifice flowmeter is the most typical differential pressure flowmeter, with the characteristics of high measurement accuracy, 
easy installation, wide range of use, simple structure and low cost, stable and reliable performance and long life, widely used 
in a variety of media flow measurement.

choice for large diameter pipe above DN200mm.
The cross section flowmeter is a differential pressure flowmeter 
based on the dynamic pressure principle and velocity area 
method. It measures the the average flow rate of the fluid with 
multiple (2 ~ 4) uniform tube sensors, so as to know the fluid 
flow. With a simple structure, wide applicable range, significant 
energy-saving effects, longterm stability and significant 
anti-clogging performance, it is especially suitable for flow 
measurement in large air ducts, boiler flues, rectangular ducts

06
Electromagnetic flowmeter is composed of sensor and converter. It works based on Faraday's law of electromagnetic 
induction and is used for conductive fluid. CP60 electromagnetic flowmeter is a product with high precision and high 
reliability after continuous upgrading and improvement. The flowmeter has reached the domestic advanced level in terms of 
excitation technology, lining technology and intelligent technology, and conforms to relevant standards such as JB/T 9248-
2015 and JJG1033-2007. It can be used to measure the conductivity of acid, alkali, salt solution, pulp, wastewater and other 
conductive media, but the medium can not contain  a large number of ferromagnetic materials and bubbles. It is widely used 
in the flow measurement of metallurgy, chemical industry, pharmaceutical industry, papermaking, environmental protection, 
petroleum, light textile, food and other industries, municipal management, water conservancy construction and other fields.
Figure 1
The measurement principle of electromagnetic flowmeter is based on Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction. A pair 
of detection electrodes are installed on the pipe wall perpendicular to the axis of the measuring tube and the magnetic 
line of the coil magnetic field. When the conductive liquid flows continuously along the axis of the measuring tube, the 
conductive liquid cuts the magnetic line in the magnetic field and generates the induced electromotive force, which acts on 
the electrode, The induced voltage is: E=KBvD (where: K is the instrument constant; B is the magnetic induction intensity; V 
is the average velocity in the cross section of the measuring tube; D is the inner diameter of the measuring tube).
When measuring the flow rate, the fluid flows through the magnetic field perpendicular to the flow direction, and the flow 
of the conductive liquid induces a voltage which is proportional to the average flow velocity. Therefore, the minimum 
conductivity of the measured flowing liquid is required. The induced voltage signal is detected by two electrodes in 
direct contact with the liquid and transmitted to the converter through the cable. After signal processing and correlation 
calculation, the accumulated flow and instantaneous flow are displayed and the signal is output at the same time.

No obstruction in the measuring pipe, and it has the same diameter with the pipe, no pressure loss, and the energy saving 
effect is outstanding
The installation requirements are simple. The front straight pipe section is 5D or above, and the rear straight pipe section 
is greater than 3D (D is the inner diameter of the instrument).
Integrated-type has a photosensitive button, and the parameters can be modified on the case, which is especially 
suitable for flameproof occasions.
The empty pipe alarm function can automatically detect and make the data return to zero and alarm, so as to prevent 
misoperation due to the wrong data.
Only the lining and electrode of the instrument are in contact with the measured medium, so the requirements of 
corrosion and wear resistance can be achieved on more occasions.
The measurement results have nothing to do with the flow velocity distribution and the physical parameters such as 
pressure, temperature, density, viscosity and conductivity (not less than the minimum conductivity), which can measure 
the flow in both positive and negative directions.

7.3 Diameter Selection
Should select a smaller diameter size of flowmeter than process pipe as the following cases:
When the measured flow rate is faster than 0.5m/s, should select the same diameter size of flowmeter as the process pipe.
7.6 Flow rate (Measuring range) Selection
Every electromagnetic flowmeter in the factory will be strict calibration and commissioning. It is better for the 
range(upper limit flow rate) close to the measured flow under the precondition of "measuring range must be larger than 
the measured flow". As usual, it should make the measured flow rate between 50%~80% of measuring range. It also is 
available to adjust the measuring range of EMF89 type electromagnetic flowmeter according to the requirement of the 
actual situation. The maximum measured flow rate can reach 12m/s.
7.5 Sensor Temperature Range Selection
Please notice that the pressure-withstanding value will reduce with the increase in temperature.
There are 6 level temperature ranges of EMF89 series electromagnetic flowmeter for measuring media(reference 
selection model sheet). It needs to select the right temperature level to ensure that the flowmeter can work well.
When the temperature of measuring media is lower than ambient, should pay attention to avoid condensation.
1.	
When the measured flow rate is too low to meet the requirement of velocity range or when the measurement 
accuracy is unsatisfactory under the lower velocity (The high-performance measuring accuracy according to the 
flow rate over 1m/s).
2.	
In an application scenario which media is easy to adhere to the tube wall: when measuring the media slurry or 
syrup, it is easy to occur scaling in pipes then influence the working of the flowmeter. Reducing the diameter of the 
flowmeter can increase the pipeline velocity with freedom from deposits formation.
7.4 Protection Grade Selection
The ingress protection grade is according to the standard of GB4208-2008 and IEC60529-2001.
IP67 grade can complete temporary water submersion. It is no problem with immersing the equipment into the water in a 
short time.
IIP68 grade is submerged type. The equipment is suitable for continuous immersion in water.
IP65 grade is water-resistant type. The equipment can withstand water projected from any direction by water tap.
When measuring freeze water, should choose IP67 or IP68 grade sensor to prevent from the frosting and fogging within 
the sensor.
The principle of selecting IP grade is according to the standard mentioned above. When installing flowmeter at a place 
where is located under the ground surface or easy to be flooded, it needs to select the IP68 sensor.
The EMF89 type converter is IP67 grade. For the requirement of IP68 sensor, should choose the split type electromagnetic 
flowmeter.

Vortex flowmeter is a kind of flowmeter based on the principle of Karman vortex street, used to measure the flow of liquid, 
gas and steam, as well as turbid liquid containing tiny particles and impurities. It is widely applied in petroleum, chemical, 
pharmaceutical, papermaking, metallurgy, electric power, environmental protection, food and other industries.
The calculation formula is as follows:

Formula 2 …………………………………………..………................. Q=3600×F/K
Formula 1 …………………………………………..………................. M=Q×ρ
Note: the instrument coefficient K varies according to the diameter of vortex flowmeter, and its specific value is obtained by flow calibration device. 
F …… Vortex frequency of fluid flowing through bluff body (Hz) 
St …… Strouhal constant (dimensionless)

area of measuring pipe (dimensionless)

Vortices
LUGB vortex flowmeter is based on the theory of vortex generation and relationship between vortex and flow rate of Carmen 
and Strouhal to measure the flow of steam, gas and low viscosity liquid. As shown in Figure 1, a triangular bluff body is 
vertically inserted into the meter. When there is medium flowing through the meter, regular Karman vortices with opposite 
directions are alternately generated behind the bluff body. The separation frequency F of the vortex is directly proportional 
to the flow velocity V of the medium. By detecting the number of vortices by the sensor head, the velocity can be calculated, 
and then the volume flow rate of the measured medium can also be calculated according to the caliber.

4.1 Installation Requirements
4.1.1 Installation Site and Environment Selection
Avoid strong power equipment, high frequency / frequency conversion equipment and strong power switch equipment;
Avoid the influence of high-temperature heat source and radiation heat source; sunshade and rainproof measures shall 
be taken for outdoor installation; 
When the flowmeter is installed, the meter body should be reliably grounded. If the field pipeline does not have the 
grounding conditions, a reliable ground wire shall be made separately to connect with the grounding end of the instrument 
shell.
4.1.3 Grounding Requirements
There must be enough straight pipe sections in the upstream and downstream of the flowmeter for accurate 
measurement, and there should be no components affecting the fluid velocity distribution in the upstream. The following 
figure shows the requirements for straight pipe section of flowmeter under various pipeline conditions.
4.1.4 Requirements for Straight Pipe 
The pipeline with strong vibration shall be avoided as far as possible; otherwise, vibration reduction measures shall be 
taken and damping sub shall be installed;
The flowmeter can be installed horizontally, vertically and obliquely. When measuring liquid, the flow direction shall be low 
to high; when measuring gas, the flow direction is not limited; when measuring steam or high temperature gas, the strut 
shall be installed at 45 ° to the vertical direction as far as possible;
4.1.2 Installation Location Selection
Avoid vibration and strong corrosion environment; convenient installation and maintenance sh™all be considered.

Product Overview
01
Sf20 series intelligent metal tube rotameter is a kind of flow instrument commonly used in industrial automation process 
control. It is small in size, wide in detection range and easy to use, which can be used to measure the flow of liquid, gas and 
steam, especially for the measurement of low velocity, small flow rate, high temperature, high pressure, strong corrosion, 
conductive or non-conductive medium.
This series of metal tube rotameter implements the enterprise standard, conforms to JB/T 6844-2015 industry standard, 
and the factory verification conforms to JJG257- 2007 verification regulation.
The product has been inspected and approved by the national explosion-proof quality inspection organization, and meets 
the relevant requirements of  GB3836.1-2010, GB3836.2-2010 and GB3836.4-2010.
2.1 Structure
Structure and Principle
02
The product mainly consists of two parts: measuring tube and indicator. The measuring tube includes taper pipe or 
orifice plate, guider, stopper, float and other components, and the indicator includes magnetic servo system, pointer, 
dial, circuit board (remote transmission) and other components.

When the medium flows through the measuring tube from bottom to top, a differential pressure is generated at the upper 
and lower ends of the float to form a lifting force. When the lifting force is greater than the weight of the float immersed in 
the fluid, the float rises. With the increase of the annular gap, the fluid velocity at the annular gap decreases rapidly, and the 
differential pressure and rising force also decrease. Until the lifting force is balanced with the weight of the floater immersed 
in the fluid, the float will be stable at a certain position, which is corresponding to the measured medium flow rate.
When the float moves up and down with the medium, the magnetic field changes with the movement of the float. In the 
indicator, the servo magnetic steel fixed on the pointer shaft is coupled with the magnetic steel in float to drive the pointer 
and sensing magnetic steel to rotate. The pointer indicates the local instantaneous flow on the dial, which is converted into 
electrical signal through the magnetic sensor, and the the instantaneous and cumulative flow are displayed after circuit 
processing.
2.2 Principle
Product Advantages
03
3.1 Specially Designed Measuring Tube and Magnetic Coupling Structure
Uniform magnetic field technology makes the float become rotor, which ensures a more stable measurement
The calibration tends to be linear by using multi-stage cone tube technology
3.2 Various Installation And Power Supply Modes
Wide voltage AC / DC power supply mode and battery power supply mode are available
Various process installation and connection modes are available for users
3.3 Dual Indication System
Low power dual line backlight with LCD digital display, can display instantaneous and cumulative flow rate and 
corresponding units at the same time. It can scroll display instantaneous flow rate, flow rate, current and percentage, 
with two-wire backlight, battery power and alarm indication functions.
Aluminum dial and long pointer mechanical indication, make the panel more beautiful
3.4 Special Self-Damping Indicator
Effectively reduce pointer jitter
Reduce the float stroke to angle ratio, effectively reduce vibration

Liquid Turbine Flowmeter 
YHLW-Y series liquid turbine flowmeter is based on the principle of torque balance and belongs to the speed flow meter. 
It has the advantages of high accuracy, good repeatability, simple structure, low pressure loss and easy maintenance. It 
is used to measure the volume flow of low viscosity liquid in closed pipeline, and it has been widely used in petroleum, 
chemical, metallurgy, water supply, paper-making and other industries.
The liquid turbine flowmeter is suitable for measuring the liquid in the closed pipe, which has no corrosive effect with 
stainless steel 1Cr18Ni9Ti, 2Cr13, corundum Al2O3 and cemented carbide, and has no fiber, particle and other impurities. 
The fluid flows through the sensor shell. As the blades of the impeller have a certain angle with the flow direction, the thrust 
of the fluid makes the blades have rotating moment. After the friction moment and fluid resistance are overcome, the 
blades rotate, and after the torque is balanced, the rotation speed is stable. Under certain conditions, the rotation speed is 
proportional to the flow velocity. As the blade has magnetic conductivity, it is in the magnetic field of the signal detector 
(composed of permanent magnetic steel and coil), the rotating blade cuts the magnetic field line and periodically changes 
the magnetic flux of the coil, so that the two ends of the coil induce an electric pulse signal, which is amplified and shaped by 
the amplifier to form a continuous rectangular pulse wave with a certain amplitude, which can be transmitted to the display 
meter to show the instantaneous flow or total volume of fluid. Within a range of flow, the pulse frequency f is proportional to 
the instantaneous flow of the sensor fluid, Q, and the flow equation is:

The flowmeter shall be kept away from external electric and magnetic fields. 
The flowmeter can be installed horizontally or vertically, and the fluid must be upward when installed vertically. During 
installation, the liquid flow direction should be consistent with the arrow indicating the flow direction on the flowmeter 
housing. 
The upstream of the flowmeter shall have a straight pipe section at least 10 times of the nominal diameter, and the 
downstream end shall have a straight pipe section at least 5 times of the nominal diameter. The inner wall of the straight 
pipe section shall be smooth and clean, free of defects such as dents, fouling and peeling. The pipe axis of the sensor 
shall be aligned with the axis of adjacent pipes, and the gasket used for connecting and sealing shall not penetrate into 
the pipe cavity. 
When the fluid contains impurities, the filter shall be installed, and the mesh of the filter shall be determined according to 
the flow rate of impurities, which is generally (20 ~ 60) mesh. When free gas is mixed in the fluid, a gas eliminator shall 
be installed. The entire piping system shall be well sealed. 
When the flowmeter is installed in the open air, the amplifier and plug should be waterproof. 
When the flowmeter is started to be used, the flow sensor shall be filled with liquid slowly, and then the outlet valve 
shall be opened. It is forbidden to be impacted by high-speed fluid when the sensor is in no liquid state. 
In order not to affect the normal transmission of liquid during maintenance, it is recommended to install bypass pipeline 
at the installation place of sensor. 
Users should fully understand the corrosivity of the measured medium to prevent the sensor from being corroded.

Gas Turbine Flowmeter 
Product overview 
01
YHLW-Q gas turbine flowmeter is a speed meter that accurately measures the gas flow. It has the characteristics of high 
measurement accuracy, good repeatability, low starting flow, and convenient installation and maintenance. It is widely 
used in petroleum, chemical, metallurgical, aviation and other sectors and gas pressure regulating stations, natural gas 
transmission and distribution pipeline networks, urban natural gas metering and other fields. 
Operating principle 
02
When the fluid flows into the flow meter, it is rectified and accelerated under the action of the air inlet rectifier. Because 
the turbine blade is at a certain angle with the flow direction of the fluid, the turbine generates a rotating torque. After 
overcoming the friction torque and fluid resistance torque, the turbine begins to rotate. In a certain flow range, the angular 
velocity of turbine rotation is directly proportional to the fluid volume flow. According to the principle of electromagnetic 
induction, the magnetic sensor is used to sense the pulse signal proportional to the fluid volume flow from the coaxial 
rotating signal wheel. After amplified, filtered and shaped, the signal, together with the temperature and pressure sensor 
signal, enters the intelligent amplifier for operation and processing, and directly displays the measured flow.

The flowmeter shall be kept away from the external electric field, magnetic field and places with strong vibration. It is 
better to install the flowmeter indoors. If it is installed outdoors, sunscreen and rainproof measures must be taken to 
avoid affecting the service life. 
The pipeline before installation or after maintenance must be purged, and the flowmeter can be installed after the debris 
in the pipeline have been removed. When welding, it is not allowed to directly weld with the flowmeter, so as not to 
damage the internal parts of the flowmeter. 
It is recommended to keep a straight pipe section with a length of at least 10DN (DN is the nominal diameter of the pipe) 
at the upstream end of the flowmeter (it can be reduced to 5DN or even 2DN in special cases), and a straight pipe section 
with a length of no less than 5 DN (it can be reduced to 2DN in special cases) at the downstream end. The inner wall 
should be smooth and clean, free of defects such as dents, dirt and peeling. The axis of the pipe of the flowmeter should 
be aligned with the axis of the adjacent pipe, and the gasket used for the connection and sealing should not go deep into 
the pipe cavity. 
When external power supply is used, the flowmeter must be reliably grounded, but it is not allowed to share the ground 
wire with the strong current system; During pipeline installation or maintenance, the grounding wire of electric welding 
system shall not be lapped with the flowmeter.
Before installing the flowmeter, remove the inlet and outlet packaging materials, and install a filter or screen (120-150 
mesh) upstream of the flowmeter (≥ 5DN) to prevent rust, welding slag and other impurities from entering the flowmeter. 
In order not to affect the normal transmission of the fluid during maintenance, it is recommended to install cut-off valves 
(globe valves) on the front and rear pipelines of the flowmeter, and set bypass pipelines at the same time. (See Figure 7) 
In general, the flowmeter is horizontally installed, and the fluid flow direction shall be consistent with the direction 
marked on the shell. 
When the pipeline is installed and tested for tightness, pay attention to the highest pressure that the flowmeter pressure 
sensor can withstand, so as not to damage the pressure sensor. 
6.1 installation 
6.2 Use
When the flowmeter is put into operation, the upstream valve of the flowmeter should be opened slowly, and then the 
downstream valve of the flowmeter should be slowly opened, so as not to damage the turbine due to the instantaneous 
excessive air flow. 
The output signal wire of the flowmeter shall be shielded wire, and the shielded end shall be grounded reliably. 
For flowmeters with explosion-proof requirements, the output wiring shall be connected in strict accordance with the 
national explosion-proof product regulations. 
It is recommended to recalibrate the sensor after six months to one year of normal use.

Isolated Safety Barrier
HD5500.AT Series
HD5500.AT series isolated barriers are designed explicitly according to latest relative standard for protection of electrical signals located in 
hazardous areas. 
Installed in safe areas, HD5500.AT series Isolated barriers work in company with intrinsically safe instruments located in hazardous areas to 
guarantee a totally IS explosion protection system. With the inside signal transfer module, HD5500.AT series isolated safety barriers can 
also play the roles of RTD temperature transmitter, thermocouple temperature transmitter and mV transmitter, as well as repeater power 
supply, solenoid driver and so on. 
Safety 
All units with IP20 degree of mechanical protection are compliant to GB3836.1-2010, GB3836.4-2010, IEC 60079-0: 2017, IEC60079-11: 
2011, EN IEC 60079-0:2018 and EN 60079-11:2012, and certified for connection into Zone0, Zone1, Zone2, Zone20, Zone21, Zone22, Ⅱ
C, ⅡB, ⅡA, T1-T6 hazardous areas worldwide. 
No high-integrity earth needed 
HD5500.AT series Isolated barriers need no dedicated ground and consequently eliminate the inherent interference of ground loop. 
Full input/output/power supply isolation 
Full 3-port isolation between the input, output and power supply circuits achieves highly floating systems for the pursuit of extraordinary 
resistibility to complicated electromagnetic interference from industrial environment. 
High performance components 
High performance components are widely adopted for optimal signal integrity, taking into account both high accuracy and low drift of full 
range. 
Compact modular design 
With compact modular design, HD5500.AT series isolated barriers provide wide application range in the minimum space.

5.
Before using the insulation resistance meter to check insulation between terminals, disconnect all of the isolated barriers. If not, the internal 
fast acting fuse would be fused.
6.
Isolated barriers are damageable. Replace the damaged barriers to ensure intrinsic safety and solve the fault together with our company. It
is forbidden to replace components of the isolated barriers without SUPCON's permission.

operation of explosion protected apparatus will have to be observed!
8.
When mounting, operating and maintaining the units, the maximum external capacitance Co and maximum external inductance Lo should 
be confirmed according to the max approval parameters from relative certificate.
9.
The max allowed voltage Um on the safe area side is 253V.

Product Introduction 
Thermal resistance (RTD) is divided into three categories: platinum thermal resistance, copper and nickel thermal resistance, which 
temperature measurement is based on that the resistance value of metal conductor increases with the increase of temperature 
Thermal resistance, thermocouple, integral temperature transmitter and bimetallic thermometer are used to measure the surface 
temperature of liquid, vapor and gas medium and solid in the temperature range of( -200~1600) ℃. It is generally used with display 
instrument, recorder, regulator, PLC and DCS system. 
Thermocouple (TC) is composed of two ends of conductors with different components connected into a loop. When the temperatures 
of the two junction points are different, electromotive force will be generated in the loop. This electromotive force is called 
thermoelectric potential, the magnitude of the thermoelectric potential is only related to the nature of the material of the conductor and 
the temperature difference at the points at its two ends. 
The integrated temperature transmitter is composed of temperature transmitter and thermal resistance or thermocouple, which 
directly converts the temperature signal into two-wire (4~20)mA signal and is compatible with HART communication, LCD and LED 
display. 
In the bimetallic thermometer, the bimetallic sheet is applied as the temperature sensing element, one end of the bimetallic sheet is 
fixed, and the other end is the free end connected with the indicator needle. The connection point generates displacement with the 
change of temperature, and drives the pointer to rotate to indicate the temperature. The bimetallic thermometer is applicable to the 
field of medium and low temperature measurement, and can directly measure the temperature of liquid, steam and gas medium within 
the range of (-80~+600) ℃ in various production processes.

01
1.1  Overview
01. Product Overview
The vortex flowmeter, designed based on the Karman vortex street principle, is used to measure 
the flow of liquid, gas and steam, as well as that of turbid liquid containing tiny particles and 
impurities. It is widely used in various industries such as petroleum, chemicals, pharmacy, paper 
making, metallurgy, electricity generation, environmental protection and food production.
02. Working Principle
LUGB vortex flowmeter, working on the principle of generated vortex and relation between 
vortex and flow by theory of Karman and Strouhal, is used to measure the flow of steam, gas and 
low viscosity liquid. As shown in Fig. 1, a bluffbody, i.e., a vortex generator, is vertically inserted 
inside the body of the flowmeter. When the fluid flows through the body of the flowmeter, regular 
Karman vortices in opposite directions are alternately generated behind the bluffbody, and the 
separation frequency, F, of the vortices is proportional to the flow velocity, V, of the medium. By 
detecting the number of vortices with the sensor head, the flow rate of the fluid can be measured, 
and the volume flow of the measured fluid can be calculated according to the diameter of the 
body of the flowmeter.

The calculation formulas are as follows:

the measured pipe (unit: dimensionless)

ρ
Fluid density (unit: kg/m

obtained through practical calibration by using a flow calibration device, that is, the number of pulses output

4.2  Selection of installation location 
04. Installation Guide 
Avoid high-voltage electric equipment, high frequency equipment, frequency converter and 
high-voltage power switchgear;
Avoid high temperature heat sources and radiation heat sources as far as possible; take 
sunshade and rainproof measures for outdoor installation;
Avoid vibration places and strong corrosive environments when possible; at the same time, 
consider the convenience for installation and maintenance.
Flowmeters should be installed with their bodies grounded reliably. If the pipeline on the site 
cannot be grounded, a separate ground wire should be connected to the ground end of the 
instrument enclosure.
For accurate measurement, enough straight pipe sections must be reserved at the upstream and 
downstream of the flowmeter, and no components affecting the distribution of fluid flow rates 
should be at the upstream. Figures below show the requirements of the straight pipe sections 
upstream and downstream the flowmeter under various pipeline conditions.
Avoid pipes with strong vibration. Otherwise, vibration reduction measures must be taken, and 
short segments for shock reduction must be installed;
The flowmeter can be installed horizontally, vertically and obliquely. For measurement of 
liquids, make sure that the fluid flows from low to high; for measurement of gases, the flow 
direction is not restricted; for measurement of steam or high-temperature gases, the body 
support of the flowmeter should be installed at 45 degrees from the vertical direction when 
possible.

4.5  Installation mode and welding of flowmeter 
Inner diameters of pipes upstream and downstream the LUGB vortex flowmeter should be 
consistent with those of the flowmeter, the sensor should be concentric with the pipeline, and the 
gasket between the sensor and flange should not protrude into the pipeline. See Fig. 4 for details 
of installation modes.
After the initial installation of the flowmeter body is completed, when the measuring medium is 
steam or other high temperature medium and the pipe is filled with such medium, the flange bolts 
should be re-tightened. Heat insulation should be provided for the pipeline to avoid damage to 
the amplifier due to too high ambient temperature.
Note: For an integrated vortex flowmeter with temperature and pressure compensation, in order to avoid 
damage to the pressure sensor due to high temperature or water hammer, be sure to close the pressure valve 
on the flowmeter body before filling the pipeline with fluid. When the pipeline is full of fluid and reaches the 
working temperature and pressure, open the valve slowly.
When the measuring medium is steam or other high temperature medium, heat insulation should be provided 
for the pipeline to avoid damage to the amplifier due to too high ambient temperature. For heat insulation, 
avoid insulating the vortex flow sensor, pressure condensing tank, pressure sensor and temperature sensor at 
the same time, for fear of steam entering the sensor and causing a short circuit!!!

4.6  Cable selection and precautions
Cables should be AVPV shielded cable above 0.5 mm
2 produced by formal manufacturers, and 
the number of cable cores should be according to the output signal type of the instrument. Cable 
diameters should be according to electrical interface specifications to ensure tightness. When 
a cable is connected with a connecting terminal, ensure that the connection is firm and reliable. 
During wiring, attention should also be paid to the reliable connection between the shielding layer 
and the amplifier housing. Generally, when stripping cables, reserve a certain excessive length of 
the shielding layer, and then lock it with the incoming wire lock nut. In this way, the connecting 
cable is locked tightly, and the shielding layer and the housing can be tightly connected. When the 
amplifier housing cannot be grounded reliably, a ground wire connected reliably with the earth 
should be led from the outer grounding end of the amplifier housing to ensure reliable grounding, 
which is very important for the stable operation of the instrument.
Note: The length of connecting cable should be less than 1000 m.
When the current is output, the circuit resistance of the conductor is 50 Ω or less; otherwise, the cable's length 
should be reduced or the cable's cross-sectional area should be enlarged to reduce the circuit resistance of the 
conductor.

5.1  X3-2 amplifier
05. Amplifier Operation 
5.1.1  Features
Table 10: Features of X3-2 amplifier
Feature
Description
Automatic recovery
The amplifier allows for backing up parameters set by the factory. 
In the case of parameters disorder of the instrument, users only 
need to restore parameters set by the factory through the “Restore 
factory settings” function in the menu, so as to ensure the normal 
measurement of the instrument.
Temperature and 
pressure compensation
The amplifier software has a built-in measurement compensation 
mode suitable for various media; temperature and pressure data can 
be automatically collected or fixed.
Output form
The amplifier has a variety of output forms to be selected by users, 
including “frequency output under working condition”, “equivalent 
pulse output”, two-wire “(4~20) mA current” and two-wire “current 
percentage”; the maximum current output can be set to any value in 
the menu by pressing buttons, and there is no need to re-check the 
zero point and full scale.
Linear correction
The amplifier software provides a 10-point linear K-factor difference 
algorithm, which allows for settings with 10-point linear correction 
at most according to the actual calibration situation, so as to improve 
the measurement accuracy of the flowmeter.
Output protection
The amplifier allows for overvoltage and overcurrent protection. 
When the current output of (4~20) mA is selected, if the current 
corresponding to the flow exceeds 22.8 mA, the system will stabilize 
the current at 22.8 mA and stop its increase to prevent too high 
current.
Input protection
The amplifier allows for overvoltage and overcurrent protection at 
the input end to prevent peak voltage or current from damaging the 
amplifier.
Automatic zeroing
The amplifier allows for automatic zeroing. With zero flow, the 
instrument can be zeroed only by touching the button for 8~10 
seconds.
Power-off/power-on 
record inquiry
The last 10 periods of power-off/power-on can be inquired (optional).
Automatic switching between battery and external power supply can be performed.
