Chapter1 Product Overview
1.1 Overview
The SL903 Series 80GHz Radar Level Meter is a high-frequency radar level
measurement instrument. It operates in the millimeter-wave band, which provides a
narrower beam angle, more concentrated energy, and stronger penetration. The
device
utilizes
advanced
intelligent
echo
tracking
technology
for
non-contact
continuous measurement of liquid, slurry, and granular materials. It is designed to
withstand high temperatures and pressures, and is suitable for various working
environments including metal and non-metal containers, reaction vessels, and solid
material silos. The product is highly reliable and versatile, capable of withstanding
harsh conditions such as those found in reactors or agitators, and is nearly unaffected
by changes in medium properties including density, pH, and viscosity.
1.2 Measuring Principle
The radar level meter emits a frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signal
via its antenna. This microwave signal travels at the speed of light and reflects off the
surface of the measured medium. The reflected signal is received by the antenna
system, amplified, filtered, and then converted into a digital signal through AD
sampling. The digital signal is processed by the processor to calculate the distance to
the target.
1.3 Product Features

Non-Contact Measurement: Nearly unaffected by corrosion, foam, water
vapor, temperature, and pressure variations.

SL903 80GHz Radar Level Meter
2

Small Beam Angle: As small as 3°, suitable for measurements in narrow
spaces or waveguide pipelines.

High Signal-to-Noise Ratio: Enhanced echo recognition and processing
capabilities.

Millimeter-Wave Radar: More concentrated energy and stronger
penetration.

FMCW High-Bandwidth Measurement: Greater accuracy.

Supports APL Two-Wire Ethernet Bus: (see selection details).

160x80 Dot Matrix LCD Display: Backlit with automatic backlight
technology.

Rich Echo Processing Algorithms: Adapted to various environmental
conditions.

Handles Harsh Conditions: Capable of measuring in strong dust, steam,
agitation, and heated environments.

Real-Time Temperature Monitoring: Automatically compensates for
temperature drift.

Sealed Electrical Components: Encapsulated to prevent moisture and
corrosion.

Dust and Rain Protection: Cover design to effectively guard against dust,
rain, and sunlight.

Chapter1 Product Overview
1.1 Overview
The SL903 Series 80GHz Muti-Parameter Radar Level Meter supports simultaneous
measurement of level, temperature, and pressure. It operates in the millimeter-wave
band, which provides a narrower beam angle, more concentrated energy, and stronger
penetration. The device utilizes advanced intelligent echo tracking technology for
non-contact continuous measurement of liquid, slurry, and granular materials. The
pressure sensor is integrated with the radar component, while the temperature sensor
supports separate installation.

1.3 Measuring Principle
The radar level meter emits a frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signal
via its antenna. This microwave signal travels at the speed of light and reflects off the
surface of the measured medium. The reflected signal is received by the antenna
system, amplified, filtered, and then converted into a digital signal through AD
sampling. The digital signal is processed by the processor to calculate the distance to
the target.

The display and adjustment module can be inserted into the sensor at any time,
usually without needing to interrupt the power supply.
The steps are as follows:

2

electronic components, rotate it to the right until it clicks into place, and then tighten the
housing cover with the viewing window.
3
To remove, follow the steps in reverse order.
4
The display and adjustment module is powered by the sensor, requiring no
additional power connection.

X600 Interactive Intelligent Calibrator & Handheld Communicator
The X600 series interactive Intelligent calibrator & handheld communicator is a handheld
tool that combines a Intelligent calibrator and HART communicator in one device. It features
a capacitive full-touch screen with a 1080P high-definition display. The device boasts a
unique detachable operation design, allowing the operation terminal to be separated for
independent use, providing convenience for on-site operations. The dual-channel full
isolation design supports dual independent output and measurement, with a signal accuracy
of up to 0.01%. The product offers easy-to-use modules like process calibration and data
recording, enabling electronic archival of calibration and recording operations.At the same
time, APL Ethernet on-site can be supported through expansion modules.
The device comes with over 1,000 built-in DD files (covering all HART Foundation certified
HART products) and can perform configuration, calibration, and troubleshooting for field
instruments like transmitters, positioners, and flow meters from various domestic and
international brands.

transmitter modules (WMT86, WMT87, WMT88), specifically designed for high-precision


RTD, thermocouple, resistance, and voltage input

Supports 2-, 3-, and 4-wire connections


digits)

Supports meter head calibration

Configurable using PC software and IDM software

2.15
Vibration Measurement Function​
​
For temperature transmitters with APL communication protocol, new sensors can be
integrated into the device body by leveraging APL instruments' multi-parameter, high-speed,
and multi-sensor signal acquisition capabilities. This enables multi-functionality and
multi-sensing in a single device. The temperature + vibration hybrid transmitter not only
measures the primary variable (temperature) but also captures 8-channel vibration data from
pipelines, tanks, reactors, and other installation locations. The system sorts frequency
values based on vibration energy intensity and uploads them as configured.

2.15.2 Installation Guidelines​
​
In the vibration measurement scenario depicted in the figure below, the medium in the
storage tank requires constant stirring, thus a motor is added to facilitate this action. Since
the stirring motor is located at the top of the storage tank, manual inspection of its operating
status is inconvenient. Therefore, other methods are needed for routine monitoring. This
vibration measurement transmitter effectively meets such usage requirements. Furthermore,
to ensure more precise vibration measurement, the transmitter should be installed close to
the motor's installation position (such as Pressure transmitter 1), and must be secured using
flanges or other reliable connection methods to prevent excessive energy attenuation.

instruments like transmitters, positioners, and flow meters from various domestic and
international brands.

02. Precautions for Operation
Thank you for buying our column magnetic reversible level guage.
The column magnetic reversible level guage takes a float as the measuring element, and uses magnetic 
steel to drive the magnetic sheet for display without energy. It is suitable for various environments 
from low temperature to high temperature and from vacuum to high pressure. It is an ideal liquid level 
measurement product for petrochemical and other industrial sectors. To ensure the correct and safe 
use of this instrument, first read the Operation Instruction carefully, which describes the installation, 
maintenance and precautions for use of the instrument. If the level guage is faulty within the warranty 
period, please contact us timely and explain the fault symptom, causes, working environment, 
specifications, etc. Then we will arrange professional after-sales personnel to give a timely reply. Our 
company does not guarantee quality problems due to removal of the level guage by the user without 
authorization or exceeding the operating temperature and pressure of the level guage during use.
The level guage has passed the pressurization, commissioning and test before delivery. After arrival, 
please check whether the packaging is damaged. To prevent damage during handling, please keep 
the product in the pre-delivery packaging state until it is handled to the work site.

03. Working Principle and Structural 
Characteristics
The float in the measuring cylinder moves up and down with the liquid level according to the 
principle of buoyancy, and the permanent magnet steel in the float drives the red and white 
reversible column to flip by 180° through magnetic coupling. When the liquid level rises, the 
reversible column turns from white to red; when the liquid level drops, the reversible column turns 
from red to white, so as to achieve the liquid level indication. A transmitter installed on the body 
of the level guage can realize remote display. The transmitter consists of sensor and converter. 
The sensor causes the reed switch in the duct to act in turn through the magnetic float fluctuation 
and magnetic coupling, and obtains the change of a resistance signal which is converted into a 
(4~20)mA standard current signal for output. An alarm switch installed on the body of the level 
guage can realize alarm or interlock control.

04. Instrument Installation and Wiring
The level guage should be installed vertically as required in a place where the operator can easily 
observe and operate it, the joint surface of flange should be fitted with gasket, and the screws of 
each component should be fastened securely;
When the cylinder is too long and has a certain deflection, try to support the cylinder. The panel 
mounting clips should not be loosened during installation;
The level guage installed on the pressure vessel should be subjected to pressure test together 
with the vessel according to the relevant provisions, or 1.25 times hydrostatic test or airtightness 
test with a pressure 1.05 times the working pressure, but the pressure should never exceed the 
maximum working pressure of the level guage. Confirm that the level guage is free of leakage 
before it is put into use;
The level guage is produced according to the user's order requirements. Since it has passed the 
commissioning and test before delivery, no commissioning is required during use generally.

06. Level Guage Maintenance
Generally, the instrument does not require maintenance;
For the measured medium containing impurities or viscous substances, frequently clean the float 
to prevent it from being stuck, and pay special attention to the direction of the float during its 
removal and installation. If the float is installed reversely, the instrument cannot work properly;
To avoid affecting the rotation and observation of the magnetic reversible column, the surface of 
the level guage should be cleaned regularly to prevent excessive dirt and dust from accumulating 
on its surface.

SL10 Magnetic Level Gauge can be used to detect the liquid level and boundary position of various tower, tank, spherical vessel and 
boiler, which makes up for the shortcomings of glass plate (tube) type liquid level meter like unclear indication and easy to break.It is 
not affected by temperature change, and there is no blind area in the whole process. The display is eye-catching, the reading is intuitive 
and the measuring range is large. It can not only display on the spot, but also remote output and control alarm, widely used in electric 
power, petrochemical, metallurgy, environmental protection, shipping, food and other industries in the production process of liquid 
level measurement and control.
The liquid level gauge is developed according to the buoyancy principle. The magnetic ball in the body of the level gauge is up or 
down with the liquid level changing. The permanent magnet will be transferred to the field indicator through magnetic coupling, and 
makes 180° dual-colored turning to show the level of medium. When the liquid level rises, the red side of display cylinder turns over. 
When the liquid level drops, the white side turns over, The red and white boundary of the indicator is the actual height of the medium 
liquid level in the container, so as to realize the liquid level measurement.

such as towers, tanks,spherical containers , boilers,etc.SL10 make up for the shortcomings of the glass plate

SL10 Working Principle
The magnetic level gauge is developed according to the buoyancy principle (Archimedes principle) and magnetic
coupling. When the liquid level in the measured container rises and falls, the float in the measuring chamber of
the level gauge also rises and falls, and the permanent magnetic steel in the float is transmitted to the field
indicator (ruler) through magnetic coupling to drive the yellow and black flap to rotate. When the liquid level
rises, the column turns from black to yellow; when the liquid level drops, the column turns from yellow to black.
The yellow and black junction of the indicator is the actual liquid level of the medium in the container.

SL20
SL20 Series Float Level Gauge

19
01
Product Overview
SL20 series float level gauge include float level transmitter and float level switch.
Float level transmitter can measure the liquid level and convert it into (4~20)mA standard signal output, the
working power supply is 24VDC, two-wire system; the transmitter can be applied to the online measurement in
petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, environmental protection and other industries.
Float level switch is one of the most practical level switches. According to its installation form, it can be side-
mounted type (side horizontal installation) or top-mounted type (top vertical installation). It is suitable for level
on/off output when the level of the measured liquid reaches a setting point in liquid storage and transportation.
02
Product Characteristics

Simple structure, economical and practical

Safe and reliable operation, high stability

Convenient installation, maintenance-free

A set of normally open, normally closed passive contacts for liquid level alarm or control
03
Working Principle
Float level transmitter is mainly composed of two parts: level sensor and current converter. When the magnetic
float changes with the liquid level, it rises and falls synchronously along the guide bar of the liquid level sensor,
so that the resistance signal inside the sensor changes linearly, and then the current converter converts this
resistance signal into a two-wire (4~20) mA DC current signal, realizing the long-distance transmission of the
liquid level signal.Float level switches utilize the leverage principle of magnetic action to make the contact switch
work.For the liquid level has frequent operation occasions, can play a role in controlling the liquid level.

SL30
SL30 Series Tuning Fork Level Switch

24
01
Product Overview
SL30 Tuning Fork Level Switch is a new type of level switch. The fork body is excited by the crystal to generate
vibration, when the end of the fork body is submerged by the liquid, the vibration frequency changes, this
change is detected by the electronic circuit and outputs a digital value, thus realizing the alarm and control of
the upper and lower limits of the level.Since tuning fork level switch has no moving parts, it require no
maintenance or adjustment.
02
Product Characteristics

Strong adaptability: the different electrical parameters of the measured liquid have no effect on the
measurement, and harsh conditions such as scaling, turbulence, agitation, bubbles, medium viscosity, high
pressure, etc. have no effect on the detection.

Maintenance-free: Since the detection process of tuning fork level switch is completed by electronic circuit,
there are no moving parts, so once installed and put into operation, there is no need for maintenance.

No need for adjustment: Since the detection of the tuning fork level switch is not affected by the electrical
parameters of the measured medium, no matter what kind of liquid is measured, no on-site adjustment is
required.
03
Working Principle
The tuning fork level switch is a new type of level control switch, which mainly relies on the tuning fork to
measure the level height through the vibration principle. The working principle of tuning fork level controller is
that a pair of piezoelectric crystals installed on the tuning fork base makes the tuning fork vibrate at a certain
resonance frequency. When the tuning fork is in contact with the measured medium, the frequency and
amplitude of the tuning fork will change, and these changes are detected by the intelligent microprocessor
circuit, then processed and converted into a digital signal.

SL80
SL80 Series Magnetostrictive Liquid Level Transmitters

28
01
Product Overview
The SL80 series magnetostrictive level gauges are designed for bulk storage monitoring and process control in
industrial environment and can be used in the oil, gas, chemical, food and beverage, biotechnology, power and
energy, marine, water engineering and other industries.
SL80 can realize 5-point output of temperature, product level, interface level or triple level simultaneously, and
the output interface is mainly 2-wire (4~20) mA and Modbus RTU. Accurate measurements can be achieved in
harsh conditions, regardless of turbulence, foam, atomization and gas stratification.
The SL80 series is available in 304, 316L, PTFE/PFA materials and can be used in most chemicals and oils. The
SL80 series is also available in both hard rod and flexible rope versions to meet different installation
requirements, with a maximum measuring range of （0-6000）mm for hard rod and （0-23000）mm for flexible
rope, and requires no regular maintenance or re-calibration after installation and calibration.
The level gauge can not only be installed into the tank for liquid level measurement, but also can be used
together with magnetic level gauge.
02
Product Characteristics

Supports synchronized detection of multiple liquid levels with high accuracy and repeatability;

Continuous measurement, absolute position output, no need to zero position for restart;

Supports up to 5-point temperature measurement;

On-site display is convenient for maintenance;

Has a variety of output methods;

Easy to use, long life, stable and reliable performance;

Low power consumption design.
03
Working Principle
The detection mechanism of the magnetostrictive level Transmitters is based on the Weidmann effect between
the magnetostrictive waveguide filament(the core detection element of the level meter ) and the vernier
magnetic ring (float).
During the measurement, the excitation module in the electronic chamber applies a query pulse at both ends of
the sensitive detecting element (waveguide filament), which forms a circumferential amperometric toroidal
magnetic field around the waveguide filament at the speed of light, and a Weidmann effect torsional stress wave
will be formed on the surface of the waveguide filament when the toroidal field couples with the biased
permanent magnetic field of the vernier magnetic ring, the torsion wave will propagate from the generating
point to the ends of the waveguide filament with the speed of sound, and the torsion wave to the end of the

29
waveguide is absorbed by the damping device, and the signal to the excitation end is received by the wave
detector.
The control module in the electronic warehouse calculates the time difference between the query pulse and the
received signal, and then multiplies it by the propagation speed of the torsion stress wave in the waveguide
material (about 2800m/s) to calculate the distance between the torsion wave occurrence position and the
measurement reference point, i.e., the absolute distance of the vernier ring relative to the measurement
reference point at that instant, thus realizing the measurement of the position of the vernier magnet ring.
04
Applications

Widely used in oil, gas, chemical, food and beverage, biotechnology, power and energy, marine, water
engineering and other industries for liquid level detection.

Float Level Gauge 


01
Product overview 
01
SL20 series float level gauges include float level analog (4 - 20)mA output and switch output. 
SL20 float level gauge (analog output) can measure the level change on site and convert (4 - 20)mA standard signal output. The 
conventional working power supply is 24VDC, two-wire system. The transmitter can be used for on-line measurement and control 
in petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, environmental protection and other industries. 
SL20 float level gauge (switch output), also known as float level switch, is a kind of simple and practical level control switch. Ac­
cording to its installation form, it can be classified into side-mounted type (horizontal installation on the side) and top-mounted 
type (vertical installation on the top). According to its application, it can be classified into common type, explosion-proof type and 
marine type. According to its detection mode, it can be classified into ordinary type and self-test type. It can bear the pressure 
of 2.5MPa at most, which is especially suitable for liquid level control or alarm in inflammable, explosive and closed high pressure 
occasions. The switch quantity of marine float level gauge is suitable for controlling and alarming the liquid level of medium in the 
tank of marine ships. The switch quantity of self-test float level gauge is equipped with manual self-test mechanism, which can ro­
tate or press the control handle to detect the controller and system in the state of no liquid level, so as to ensure the safe operation 
of the controller and system.

1. Product Overview
SL20 Series Float Level Instrument includes float level transmitter
and float level switch.
Float level transmitter can measure the level and convert it into
(4~20)mA standard signal output, the working power supply is 24VDC,
two-wire system. The transmitter can be applied to the measurement in
petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, environmental protection.
Float level switch is one of the most practical level switches.
According to its installation form, it can be side- mounted type (side
horizontal installation) or top-mounted type (top vertical installation). It
is suitable for level on/off output when the level of the measured liquid
reaches a setting point in liquid storage .

2. Principle and Characteristics
2.1. Working principle
Float level transmitter is mainly composed of two parts: level sensor
and current converter. When the magnetic float changes with the level, it
rises and falls synchronously along the guide rod of the level sensor, so
that the resistance signal inside the sensor changes linearly, and then the
current
converter
converts
this
resistance
signal
into
a two-wire
(4~20)mA DC current signal, realizing the long-distance transmission of
the level signal. Float level switches utilize the leverage principle of
magnetic action to make the contact switch work, which can play an
important role in liquid level control of frequent operation.

Debugging should be performed before leaving the factory, so

Overview 
01
SL903 series 80GHz radar level meter is a high-frequency radar level measurement instrument, with millimetre wave band, 
smaller beam angle, more concentrated energy, stronger penetration, and advanced intelligent echo tracking processing 
technology, which can continuously measure the level of liquid, slurry and granular materials in a non-contact way.The 
product is high temperature resistant, high pressure resistant, non-contact, suitable forIt is suitable for various metal 
and non-metal containers, reactors or solid silos and other working environments. It can withstand the harsh working 
conditions of reactors and stirred tanks, easy to install and debug, and is nearly .It is unaffected by any changes in media 
properties including density, PH and viscosity.
Measuring Principle 
02
Radar level meter through the antenna transmits a FMCW (Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave) signal, the microwave 
signal propagates in space at the speed of light, and is reflected back after contacting the surface of the measured medium 
and is received by the antenna system. The signal is amplified, filtered and other pre-processing, then sampled by the 
AD to get a digital signal, then sent to the processor for data processing, and finally calculated to get the distance of the 
measured target.Finally, the distance of the measured target is calculated.

SL902  Series

13
Overview 
01
SL902 Series 26GHz Radar Level Transmitter is a high frequency radar level measurement instrument. With the mature 
manufacturing process, multiple options of process connection, customized components and advanced intelligent echo 
tracking management technology, it enables non-contact continuous level measurement of the liquid, slurries and solids. 
As it is resistant to high temperature and high pressure as well as its non-contact structure, it can be applied in a variety 
of metallic and non-metallic vessels, reactors, solids silos and etc. The product can withstand harsh working conditions 
in the reactors and mixing tanks, as it is not only easy to do installation and commissioning, but also hardly be affected by 
any media characteristics change including the density, PH and viscosity.
Measuring Principle 
02
The radar level meter emits extremely narrow microwave signals through an RF circuit, which are transmitted downwards 
through an antenna. The microwave propagates at the speed of light in space, contacts the surface of the measured 
medium, and is reflected back and received by the antenna system. The signal is preprocessed by amplification, filtering, 
etc., then sampled by AD to obtain a digital signal, which is sent to the processor for data processing. Finally, the distance 
of the measured target is calculated.

19

20
Overview
01
SL901 series guided wave radar level meter adopts advanced microprocessor and unique choDiscovery echo processing 
technology, with a variety of process connections and detection components, suitable for a variety of complex conditions 
and applications, especially for high temperature and high pressure and small dielectric constant medium. The guided 
wave radar level meter adopts pulse working mode, with very low emission power, and can be installed in all kinds of metal 
and non-metal containers, which is harmless to human body and environment.
Measuring Principle
02
Guided-wave radar emits high-frequency microwave pulses that propagate along the detection component (guided-
wave rod or guided-wave cable), and when it encounters the measured medium, due to the sudden change of dielectric 
constant, it causes reflection, and a part of the pulse energy is reflected back. The time interval between the emitted pulse 
and the reflected pulse is proportional to the distance of the measured medium, and the polarity and amplitude of the echo 
depends on the upper medium and the dielectric constant of the lower medium.

1.
Product overview
SL902 series 26GHz radar level meter is a high frequency radar level
measurement instrument with mature manufacturing processes. It has
multiple process connection options and customizable components, uses
advanced intelligent echo tracking processing technology, and can
perform non-contact continuous measurement of the level of liquids,
slurries, and granular materials. The product is high
temperature
resistant, high pressure resistant, and contactless, suitable for various
metallic and non-metallic containers, reactors or solid material silos, and
other working environments. It can withstand the harsh conditions of
reactors and stirring tanks, is easy to install and debug, and is almost
unaffected by any medium characteristics including density, pH, and
viscosity changes.
1.1. Measuring principle
The radar level meter emits a narrow microwave signal through a
radio frequency circuit, which is transmitted downwards through the
antenna. The microwaves propagate through space at the speed of light,
and when they come into contact with the surface of the measured
medium, they are reflected back and received by the antenna system.
The signal undergoes preprocessing such as amplification and filtering,
then it is digitally sampled through an AD converter and sent to a
processor for data processing. Finally, the distance to the measured
target is calculated.

1.
Product overview
SL903 series 80GHz radar level meter is a high frequency radar level
measurement instrument with millimeter waveband, smaller beam angle,
more concentrated energy and stronger penetration. It adopts advanced
intelligent
echo
tracking
processing
technology,
and
can
make
non-contact continuous measurement of level of liquid, slurry and
granular materials. The product is resistant to high temperature, high
pressure and no contact, and is suitable for a variety of working
environments such as various metal and non-metal vessels, reactors or
solid silos. It can withstand the harsh conditions of reactors and mixing
tanks, is easy to install and commission, and is virtually unaffected by any
media characteristics including density, PH and viscosity changes.
1.1. Measuring principle
The radar level meter transmits a frequency modulated continuous
wave (FMCW) signal through the antenna, which is reflected by the
medium and received by the antenna as an echo with different
frequencies. The change in frequency is proportional to the distance and
is converted to the level height.

2

measurement,

and


Beam angles as small as 3°, suitable for measurements in
confined spaces or guided wave ducts.

Excellent signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for better echo quality;

Millimeter band radar with more concentrated energy and
better penetration.

FM continuous wave (FMCW) high bandwidth measurements
for greater accuracy.

160x80 dot matrix LCD backlit liquid crystal display.

Rich echo processing algorithms and empirical data adaptation
for various types of working environments.

High-temperature, high-pressure reactor environments, with
either out-of-tank penetration measurements or see-through
measurements through quartz glass isolation flanges.

For strong dust, steam and other extremely harsh working
conditions and special process storage tank applications with



01
Product Overview
01
W series temperature instrument mainly consists of resistance temperature detector(RTD), thermocouple(TC), temperature 
transmitter, integrated temperature transmitter and bimetallic thermometer, etc. It is suitable for temperature measurement 
in petroleum, chemical, electric power, metallurgy, building materials, food, pharmacy, papermaking, water treatment, road 
and bridge, building and textile industries. 
RTD can be divided into 3 categories, platinum RTD, copper RTD and nickel RTD, whose measurement base on the 
characteristics that the resistance of the metal conductor increase when the  temperature increase.
Two conductor of different components connected both ends to make the circuit of TC. When the temperature of the two 
joints are different at the same time, in the circuit will produce an electric potential, this electric potential is called the 
thermal potential, the magnitude of the thermal potential is only related to the nature of the conductor material and the 
temperature difference between its two end points.
Integrated temperature transmitter consists of temperature transmitter, RTD or TC, which converts the temperature signal 
directly into 2-wire (4~20) mA signal and supports HART, 485 communication and LCD, LED display.
RTD, TC, integrated temperature transmitter are used to measure the surface temperature of liquid, steam and gas media 
as well as solids within the range of (-200~1600)℃. They are generally used in conjunction with display instruments, 
recorders, regulators, PLC and DCS systems.
Bimetallic thermometer adopts bimetallic strip as the temperature sensing component. One end of the bimetallic strip 
is fixed, the other end is free and connects with the indicator needle. The connection point moves with the change of 
temperature, driving the pointer to rotate to indicate the temperature.
Bimetallic thermometers are suitable for measurement of low and medium temperature at the site. It can directly measure 
a variety of  (-80 ~ 500) ℃ liquid, steam and gas medium generated during production.
Product Presentation
02

02
Pipe diameter support a variety of process occasions, mainly consists of straight type, taper type and step type (variable 
diameter type), etc.
Junction box protection grade IP65 (up to IP68).
Have a full range of instrument. RTD, TC, integrated temperature transmitters and bimetallic thermometers are suitable 
for anti-corrosion, wear-resistant, high-temperature requirement and other special occasions and also suitable for 
power plants, petrochemicals and many other specialized occasions.
Explosion-proof grade Ex d IIC T6 Gb, intrinsically safe grade Ex ia IIC T6 Ga; Citation standards: “GB 3836.1-2010 Explo­
sive Environment Part 1: General Requirements for the Equipment”, “GB 3836.2 2000 Electrical Equipment for Explosive 
Gas Environments Part 2: Flame-proof type “d “”.
A variety of forms of protection tube such as steel pipe welding type, single-ended deep blind holes in the overall 
drilling type, high pressure resistant type.
High precision and stability. Integrated temperature transmitter has built-in cold end compensation. The permitted 
deviation and precision of RTD, TC, integrated temperature transmitter show in  table 2-1, 2-2 and 2-3.

Chapter 1 General introduction
Overview
The X600 Series Interactive Intelligent Calibrator & Communicator (hereinafter
referred to as the “Product”) is a handheld instrument product that adopts the
capacitor-type touch screen and 1080P HD display and integrates the intelligent
calibrator and HART communicator. The Product adopts the unique separable operation
design that supports the separation of the operating terminal from the product for
independent use, which improves the convenience of field operation. It supports the
independent output and measurement of both channels. In addition, it provides some
convenient and easy functions, such as process calibrator and recorder for electronic
archiving of operations, e.g. calibration and record.
This product allows you to configure, calibrate and troubleshoot field instruments
(e.g., transmitters, positioners, etc.) and control systems (e.g., modules, components,
etc.). The Product owns the HART communication function and supports the electronic

1.8.1
OTG(reverse charging)
The OTG function is designed to improve the product endurance. After the OTG function
is enabled, when the host power is low and the terminal is fully charged,
the terminal will automatically start the reverse charging and supply
power to the host, effectively prolonging the service life of the Product.
When the host power reaches a certain level or the terminal power drops
below a certain level, the reverse charging will be disabled automatically. When the
actual situation meets the conditions, the reverse charging will start again. After the
[Enable OTG] is disabled, the terminal will no longer supply power to the host. The
function will be enabled again only when the terminal is restarted or the [Enable OTG]
is enabled again. During the reverse charging, the battery icon is as shown in the right
figure. In this case, the host is being charged.
If the X600 under OTG status needs to be connected to a PC for data transmission,
the above "Enable reverse charging function" must be disabled.
If the X600 under OTG status is connected to an external charger for charging,
the terminal will not be charged during a short time, which is a normal
phenomenon. The charging will return to normal after the internal reverse
charging is disconnected.

OVERVIEW
Established in the 1990's, SUPCON Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "SUPCON", stock code: 688777.SH, 
SUPCON.SW) is a global pioneer in industrial AI solutions, leveraging industrial data, advanced AI models, and 
full-scenario intelligent systems to reshape production, operations, and decision-making in process industries. By 
integrating "technology innovation" and "business model innovation", the company pioneers next-generation AI-driv-
en productivity, accelerating the transition from industrial automation to autonomous operations. Guided by its 
mission of "Elevate Industrial Intelligence, Drive Customer Success" , SUPCON has developed a "1+2+N" AI-powered 
Enterprise Operation Architecture—a modular framework that delivers tailored solutions across "AI + Safety", "AI + 
Quality", "AI + Green", and "AI + Profit". Through its "Technology + Application Scenarios + Ecosystem" strategy, the 
company is driving sector-wide transformation from fragmented automation to end-to-end intelligent workflows, 
fostering a robust AI ecosystem that bridges R&D, real-world applications, and cross-industry collaboration. 
SUPCON's cutting-edge technologies serve over 35,000 clients in more than 50 countries, spanning industries such as 
chemicals, petrochemicals, oil & gas, power, pharmaceuticals, metallurgy, building materials, pulp & paper, 
new materials, food & beverage, and more. Its solutions empower global process industries to 
achieve high-quality, sustainable growth while advancing the creation of safer, greener, and 
more efficient industrial environments worldwide.
Zhejiang SUPCON Instrument Co., Ltd. (referred to as "SUPCON Instrument"), a subsidiary of 
SUPCON Technology, undertakes the critical mission of advancing intelligent field instrumentation. 
Through over two decades of relentless innovation, SUPCON Instrument has established a compre-
hensive automation instrumentation product portfolio covering temperature, pressure, flow, and 
level measurement devices.
Leveraging APL industrial network technology, SUPCON Instrument integrates smart diagnostics and 
device management into end-to-end solutions spanning instruments, networks, and control 
systems. This approach reduces smart manufacturing costs, accelerates deployment, and enhances 
operational intelligence.
Its products meet stringent global standards, holding TUV SIL2/SIL3 safety certifications, IECEX/ATEX 
explosion-proof approvals, NEPSI dual explosion-proof certification, CE and HART.
Trusted by Fortune 500 leaders like SINOPEC, CNPC, and CNOOC, SUPCON Instrument is a globally

rapid and accurate diagnosis and maintenance of field devices.
Its intrinsically safe design meets stringent explosion-proof requirements in high-risk industries such as oil & gas, chemi-
cal, and energy.

1.1 Product Overview 
1.2  Working principle
01. Product Overview
YHLW-Q gas turbine flowmeter is an instrument to  measure gas flow accurately. It has the 
characteristics of high accuracy, good repeatability, low starting flow, convenient installation and 
maintenance, etc. It is widely used in petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, aviation and other industries. 
Including gas pressure regulating stations, natural gas transmission and distribution pipeline network, 
urban natural gas metering and other fields. 
When the fluid flows into the flowmeter, it is rectified and accelerated by the action of the air inlet 
rectifier. Because the turbine blades and the fluid flow are at a certain angle, the turbine generates a 
rotating torque. After overcoming the friction torque and fluid resistance torque, the turbine begins to 
rotate. Within a certain flow range, the angular velocity of the turbine rotation is proportional to the 
fluid volume flow.
According to the principle of electromagnetic induction, a magnetic sensor is used to induce a pulse 
signal proportional to the volume flow of the fluid from the coaxially rotating signal wheel.
After the signal is amplified, filtered, and reshaped, it enters the smart amplifier together with the 
temperature and pressure sensor signals for arithmetic processing, and directly displays the measured 
flow rate.

4.1 Installation 
04. Installation and use
The flowmeter should be far away from external electric fields, magnetic fields and strong vibration 
sites. The flowmeter is preferably installed indoors. Once installed outdoors, sun protection and 
rain protection measures must be taken to avoid affecting the service life. 
It is recommended to retain a straight pipe section with a length of at least 10DN(DN is pipe 
nominal diameter) at the upstream end of the flowmeter (in special cases, it can be reduced to 5DN 
or even 2DN), and a straight pipe section with a length of no less than 5DN at the downstream end 
(which can be reduced to 2DN in special cases) shall have a smooth and clean inner wall without 
indentation, fouling, peeling and other defects. The pipe axis of the flowmeter should be aligned 
with the axis of the adjacent pipe, and the gasket for connecting and sealing shall not penetrate into 
the inner cavity of the pipe. 
The inlet and outlet packages should be removed before installing the flowmeter. A filter or filter 
screen (120~150 mesh) should be installed at upstream of the flowmeter (≥ 5DN) to prevent rust 
slag, welding slag and other impurities from entering the flowmeter. 
 The flowmeter is generally installed horizontally, and the direction of fluid flow should be 
consistent with the direction indicated by the shell. 
 When the external power supply is used, the flowmeter must have reliable grounding, but it should 
not share ground lines with the high-power system; During pipeline installation or maintenance, 
the ground wire of the welding system shall not be overlapped with the flowmeter; 
In order to avoid affecting the normal delivery of fluid during maintenance, it is recommended to 
install a cut-off valve (stop valve) on the front and rear pipelines of the flowmeter, and at the same 
time, a bypass pipe should be set. (Figure 3) 
When the pipeline is installed for sealing and pressing, attention should be paid to the maximum 
pressure that the flowmeter pressure sensor can withstand to avoid damage to the pressure sensor. 
 The pipeline before installation or after overhaul must be blown, and the flowmeter can be 
installed after removing debris in the pipeline. During welding, direct welding is not allowed with 
the flowmeter to avoid damage to the internal parts of the flowmeter. 

07
4.2  Usage 
Fig.3 Schematic diagram of bypass pipe installation 
 When the flowmeter is put into operation, the upstream valve of the flowmeter shall be opened 
slowly first, and then the downstream valve of the flowmeter shall be opened slowly to avoid 
damage to the turbine due to excessive instantaneous air flow. 
After the sensor is normally used for half a year to one year, recalibration is recommended. 
For flowmeters with explosion-proof requirements, the output wiring shall be connected in strict 
accordance with the provisions of national explosion-proof products. 
The output signal line of the flowmeter should be shielded, and the shielding end should be reliably 
grounded.

5.1  X3-2 Intelligent amplifier 
05. Amplifier 
5.1.1 X3-2 Amplifier functional characteristics  
Automatic recovery function: the amplifier has the function of backing up factory parameters. In 
the case of faulty instrument parameters, users only need to restore factory parameters through the 
"Restore factory setting" function in the menu to ensure the normal measurement of the instrument.  
Output form: the amplifier provides a variety of output forms for users to choose, including 
"frequency output under working condition", "equivalent pulse output", two-wire system "(4~20)
mA current", and two-wire system "current percentage". The upper limit of current output can be 
arbitrarily set in the menu by pressing the key without rechecking the zero and fullness. 
Linear correction function: the amplifier software provides a 10-point linear meter coefficient 
difference algorithm, which can set up to 10-point linear correction according to actual calibration, so 
as to improve the measurement accuracy of the flowmeter. 
Output protection function: The amplifier has the function of overvoltage and overcurrent protection 
circuit. When the (4~20)mA current output is selected, if the current value corresponding to the flow 
exceeds 22.8mA, the system will stabilize the current value at 22.8mA without increasing, to prevent 
excessive current. 
Input protection function: It has input over-voltage and over-current protection function to prevent 
peak voltage or current from damaging the amplifier.  
Automatic zero adjustment function: the amplifier has the function of automatically adjusting zero 
points. In the case of zero flow in the pipeline, the zero setting of the instrument can be completed by 
touching the key for 8 seconds to 10 seconds.  
Incoming power outage query function: the time of the last 10 power outages can be checked. 
(Optional) 
Automatic switching between the battery and the external power supply: when the battery is 
powered on, if the external power supply is connected, it will automatically switch to the external 
power supply status, and the battery no longer works; If the external power supply is turned off, the 
battery will be restarted.

5.1.9 Setting method of X3-2 linear correction coefficient (see the setting method of 
segmented compensation for liquid temperature) 
During instrument calibration, the parameter "output form" should be set to "working frequency", 
"small signal elimination value" should be set to 0, and dial switch KP of terminal board should be 
turned on. After calibration, set the "instrument coefficient" according to the actual calibration, and 
then change the "output form", "small signal elimination value" and the terminal board dial switch 
back to the original setting. 
Flow stabilization time at the calibration point: ≥ 60s. 
F1 ~ F10 and K1 ~ K10 are the frequencies and coefficients corresponding to the actual calibration 
points of the instrument. See the following figure. The frequencies and coefficients of the 10 sets 
of breakpoints do not need to be set completely, but must be continuously set from small to large 
starting from Frequency I and Coefficient I, and the frequencies and coefficients of the other 
breakpoints must remain the original default value of 0. 
Linear correction instrument coefficient algorithm: 
— When F<F1, K = K1; 
— When F1 ≤ F<F2, K =(F-F1)(K2-K1)/(F2-F1)+ K1; 
— When F2 ≤ F<F3, K =(F-F2)(K3-K2)/(F3-F2)+ K2; 
—When F3 ≤ F< F4, K = (F-F3)(K4-K3)/(F4-F3) + K3; 
—When F4 ≤ F< F5, K = (F-F4)(K5-K4)/(F5-F4) + K4;

01.  Product Overview
02. Working principle
YHLW-Y series liquid turbine flowmeter is designed on torque balance principle and it’s a velocity 
flow instrument. With its high accuracy, good repeatability, simple structure, low pressure loss, easy 
maintenance and other features, it can be used to measure the volume flow of low viscosity liquids in 
closed pipeline system. Therefore, it is widely used in petroleum, chemistry, metallurgy, water supply, 
papermaking and other industries. 
The liquid turbine flowmeter is suitable for measuring the liquid that does not corrode with stainless 
steel 1Cr18Ni9Ti, 2Cr13, corundum Al         , and cemented carbide in closed pipelines; there should be 
no fibers, particles or other impurities in the liquid.
Fluid flowing through the sensor shell, as a result of the impeller blade and flow to a certain point 
of view, the impact of fluid blade with rotational torque, to overcome the friction torque and fluid 
resistance, blade rotation speed stability after the moment balance, under certain conditions, the 
speed is proportional to the velocity of flow, because the blade has a magnetic conductivity, it is in the 
signal detector (consists of permanent magnets and coils) magnetic field In, the rotating blade cuts the 
magnetic field lines, periodically changing the magnetic flux of the coil, so that the two ends of the 
coil are induced by the electric pulse signal, which is amplified and shaped by the amplifier to form 
a continuous rectangular pulse wave with a certain range, which can be transmitted to the display 
instrument to show the instantaneous flow or total amount of the fluid. In certain flow range, pulse 
frequency f is proportional to instantaneous flow Q of the fluid which flows through the sensor, flow 
equation: Q=3600 x —f

the connection is reliable. During connection, it should also be noted that the shielding layer must be 
reliably connected to the amplifier housing. Generally, during stripping, a certain amount of margin 
is reserved for the shielding layer, and then locked with the incoming nut. In this way, not only the 
connection cables are locked tightly, but also the shielding layer can be tightly connected to the 
housing. When the amplifier housing cannot be reliably grounded, a ground wire reliably connected 
with the earth shall be led from the grounding end outside the amplifier shell to ensure the reliability 
of grounding, which is very important for the stable operation of the instrument.
Note: The length of the connection cable should be less than 500 meters.

The flowmeter is strictly debugged and calibrated before leaving the factory, and users 
generally no longer need to do zero debugging when use.
However, if the working condition (such as vibration, frequency conversion, strong                     
electromagnetic field interference, etc.) is changed that brings the zero point shift, it is 
necessary to make appropriate adjustment to the zero point of the flowmeter. If zero point 
adjustment is required, please contact us in time and the after-sale service engineer will 
guide the operation.
The zero point adjustment is mainly to return the output signal or instantaneous flowrate back to 
the zero point when there is no flowrate in the pipeline. The magnification potentiometer R9 and the 
sensitivity potentiometer R20 are located respectively in symmetrical left and right positions on the 
front of the amplifier circuit board.
Magnification potentiometer R9: No need to adjust after leaving the factory.
Sensitivity potentiometer R20 adjustment method: increase the sensitivity counterclockwise and 
decrease the sensitivity clockwise.
The principle of sensitivity adjustment is to make the sensitivity as high as possible when the           
flowmeter is installed correctly, the pipeline is filled with medium that is not running, and the output 
signal of the flowmeter can return to zero. The sensitivity potentiometer is generally adjusted 
counterclockwise to the end when leaving the factory, and then adjusted clockwise between the 
third and fifth channels. For newly installed or re-used flowmeter, when the actual medium flowrate 
in the pipeline is zero but the meter output is not zero, the sensitivity potentiometer can be adjusted. 
The specific method is to adjust the sensitivity potentiometer counterclockwise to end and slowly 
adjust the sensitivity potent instrument clockwise until the meter output signal just returns to zero.

Function
Description of features
Automatic recovery 
function
The amplifier has the function of backing up factory parameters. In the case of  
incorrect instrument parameters, users only need to reset factory parameters 
through the “reset factory setting” function in the menu to ensure the normal     
measurement of the instrument.
Output forms
The amplifier provides a variety of output forms for users to choose from, including 
“frequency output under working condition”, “Pulse Equivalency output”, two-wire 
“(4~20)mA current”, and two-wire “current percentage”. The upper limit value of 
current output can be set in the menu by pressing the key,   no need to re-calibrate 
the zero point and full degree. 
Linear correction 
function
The amplifier software provides a 10 point linear instrument coefficient difference 
algorithm, which can make up to 10 point linear correction setting according to the 
actual calibration situation to improve the accuracy of the flowmeter. 
Output protection 
function
The amplifier allows for overvoltage and overcurrent protection. When the current 
output of (4~20) mA is selected, if the current corresponding to the flow exceeds    
22.8 mA, the system will stabilize the current at 22.8 mA and stop its increase to 
prevent too high current.
Input protection 
function
The amplifier has the function of input overvoltage and overcurrent protection, the 
damages to amplifier caused by peak electric voltage or current can be prevented.
Automatic zero 
adjustment 
function
The amplifier has automatic zero adjustment function. In the case of zero flow in the 
pipeline, the zero setting of instrument can be completed solely by a gentle touch on 
the key for 8 ~ 10 seconds.
Power-off/power-on 
record inquiry
The last 10 periods of power-off/power-on can be inquired (optional).
Automatic switching 
function between 
battery and external 
power supply
In battery power supply state, if the external power supply is connected, it will 
automatically switch to the external power supply, and the battery will not work; If 
the external power supply is disconnected, the battery will work again.

Linear correction instrument coefficient algorithm: 
— When F<F1, K = K1; 
— When F1 ≤ F<F2, K =(F-F1)(K2-K1)/(F2-F1)+ K1;

—When F3 ≤ F< F4, K = (F-F3)(K4-K3)/(F4-F3) + K3;
—When F4 ≤ F< F5, K = (F-F4)(K5-K4)/(F5-F4) + K4; 
—When F5 ≤ F< F6, K = (F-F5)(K6-K5)/(F6-F5) + K5;
—When F6 ≤ F< F7, K = (F-F6)(K7-K6)/(F7-F6) + K6;
—When F7 ≤ F< F8, K = (F-F7)(K8-K7)/(F8-F7) + K7;
—When F8 ≤ F< F9, K = (F-F8)(K9-K8)/(F9-F8) + K8;

—When F10 ≤ F, K = K10.

Calibration method
When the instrument is calibrated, the linear correction (i. e., Y1 ~ Y5 is set to 1) shall be turned 
off and connected in the form of pulse output; After calibration, set the instrument coefficient and 
correction according to the actual standard, and restore the original wiring. 
Flow stabilization time at calibration point: ≥ 60s

F1~F5 and Y1~Y5 are the frequencies and correction factors corresponding to the actual 
calibration points of the instrument, and F1~F5 must be set from small to large. When less than 5 
points are corrected, the correction factor of the subsequent points shall be set according to that
